source_text: The Reserve Bank of India today announced a 25 basis point cut in the repo rate.
reference_translation: भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक ने आज रेपो दर में 25 आधार अंकों की कटौती की घोषणा की।
candidate_translation: भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक ने आज रेपो दर में 25 आधार अंकों की कटौती की घोषणा की।
judge_explanation: Fully accurate and fluent. Correct financial terminology (रेपो दर, आधार अंक) and appropriate formal news register. No loss or distortion of information.

source_text: Hey, are you free this weekend? Let's catch a movie.
reference_translation: अरे, क्या तुम इस वीकेंड फ्री हो? चलो कोई मूवी देखते हैं।
candidate_translation: अरे, क्या तुम इस वीकेंड फ्री हो? चलो कोई मूवी देखते हैं।
judge_explanation: Natural, colloquial Hindi that matches how urban Hindi speakers actually talk, including realistic English code-mixing (वीकेंड, फ्री, मूवी). Register and tone match the casual source perfectly.

source_text: Restart the router and wait for the lights to turn green before reconnecting.
reference_translation: राउटर को रीस्टार्ट करें और दोबारा कनेक्ट करने से पहले लाइट्स के हरे होने का इंतज़ार करें।
candidate_translation: राउटर को रीस्टार्ट करें और दोबारा कनेक्ट करने से पहले लाइट्स के हरा होने का इंतज़ार करें।

errors.note: Gender/number agreement error: 'हरा' should be 'हरे' to agree with plural 'लाइट्स'. Instruction remains fully understandable.

judge_explanation: Instructions are clear and actionable; the only issue is a small adjective-agreement slip that a native speaker would barely notice and that does not affect comprehension.

source_text: We regret to inform you that your application has not been shortlisted for the next round.
reference_translation: हमें आपको यह सूचित करते हुए खेद है कि आपके आवेदन को अगले दौर के लिए नहीं चुना गया।
candidate_translation: हम आपको बताना चाहते हैं कि आपका आवेदन अगले दौर के लिए नहीं चुना गया।

errors.note: Drops the apologetic/formal tone of 'regret' (खेद है), making the rejection sound blunter than intended, though the factual content is fully correct.

judge_explanation: Core message (rejection) is conveyed correctly, but the softening, formal tone expected in this kind of letter is lost, making it read slightly curt for the genre.

source_text: This blender comes with a 2-year warranty, three speed settings, and a free recipe book.
reference_translation: इस ब्लेंडर पर 2 साल की वारंटी, तीन स्पीड सेटिंग्स, और एक मुफ़्त रेसिपी बुक मिलती है।
candidate_translation: इस ब्लेंडर पर 2 साल की वारंटी और तीन स्पीड सेटिंग्स मिलती हैं।

errors.note: The free recipe book, a distinct product feature/selling point, is completely dropped from the translation.

judge_explanation: Warranty and speed settings are translated correctly, but a full feature (free recipe book) is missing, which matters for a product listing where every listed benefit is meant to inform the buyer.

source_text: Please find attached the invoice for your recent purchase.
reference_translation: कृपया अपनी हाल की खरीद का इनवॉइस देखें, जो साथ में संलग्न है।
candidate_translation: अपनी खरीद का बिल देख ले, अटैच किया है।

errors.note: Uses the तू-level informal imperative 'देख ले' in what should be a formal business communication - a jarring register mismatch that would read as rude or unprofessional to a Hindi business reader.

judge_explanation: The factual content survives, but the informal, almost curt phrasing is completely inappropriate for a formal business email and would likely be perceived as disrespectful by the recipient.

source_text: The company reported a 12% increase in quarterly profits, reaching $4.5 billion.
reference_translation: कंपनी ने तिमाही मुनाफे में 12% की बढ़ोतरी दर्ज की, जो 4.5 अरब डॉलर तक पहुंच गई।
candidate_translation: कंपनी ने तिमाही मुनाफे में 12% की गिरावट दर्ज की, जो 4.5 अरब डॉलर तक पहुंच गई।

errors.note: 'गिरावट' means 'decline', the exact opposite of 'increase'. The number and dollar figure are correct, but the core financial fact is reversed.

judge_explanation: This is fluent, well-formed Hindi that reads convincingly, which makes it dangerous: it reports a profit decline when the source reports a profit increase - a complete reversal of the key fact in a financial news item.

source_text: Can you send me the updated invoice by tomorrow morning?
reference_translation: क्या तुम मुझे कल सुबह तक अपडेटेड इनवॉइस भेज सकते हो?
candidate_translation: Can you send me the updated invoice by tomorrow morning?

errors.source_span: Can you send me the updated invoice by tomorrow morning?
errors.candidate_span: Can you send me the updated invoice by tomorrow morning?
errors.note: Output is identical to the source; no translation occurred at all.

judge_explanation: The model returned the English source text unchanged. This provides zero value to a Hindi-only reader and constitutes a complete task failure, not a quality issue on a spectrum.

source_text: I don't think I can make it tonight, something came up.
reference_translation: मुझे नहीं लगता मैं आज रात आ पाऊंगा, कुछ काम आ गया है।
candidate_translation: मुझे नहीं लगता मैं आज रात आ पाऊंगा, दफ्तर में एक बड़ी इमरजेंसी आ गई है।

errors.candidate_span: दफ्तर में एक बड़ी इमरजेंसी आ गई है
errors.note: Fabricates a specific reason ('a big office emergency') that is not present in or implied by the vague source phrase 'something came up'.

judge_explanation: The translator invented specific, unsupported details. In a subtitle context this changes what the speaker is understood to have actually said, which is a meaningful fidelity error even though the sentence reads naturally.

source_text: It's raining cats and dogs outside, don't forget your umbrella.
reference_translation: बाहर मूसलाधार बारिश हो रही है, अपनी छाता मत भूलना।
candidate_translation: बाहर बिल्लियाँ और कुत्ते बरस रहे हैं, अपनी छाता मत भूलना।

errors.candidate_span: बिल्लियाँ और कुत्ते बरस रहे हैं
errors.note: Literal word-for-word rendering of an English idiom produces a surreal, nonsensical image in Hindi instead of the intended meaning 'heavy rain'.

judge_explanation: Grammatically fluent but semantically broken: a Hindi reader would be confused rather than understanding that it is simply raining heavily. The idiom needed sense-for-sense, not word-for-word, translation.

source_text: प्रधानमंत्री ने कल नई दिल्ली में एक महत्वपूर्ण बैठक की अध्यक्षता की।
reference_translation: The Prime Minister chaired an important meeting in New Delhi yesterday.
candidate_translation: The Prime Minister chaired an important meeting in New Delhi yesterday.
judge_explanation: Accurate, fluent, and uses correct English news register with no loss of information.

source_text: यार, कल रात की पार्टी बहुत मज़ेदार थी!
reference_translation: Dude, last night's party was so much fun!
candidate_translation: Dude, last night's party was so much fun!
judge_explanation: Captures both meaning and casual tone naturally; 'यार' is idiomatically rendered as 'Dude' rather than a stiff literal equivalent.

source_text: सॉफ्टवेयर अपडेट करने से पहले अपने सभी डेटा का बैकअप ज़रूर लें।
reference_translation: Before updating the software, make sure to back up all your data.
candidate_translation: Before updating the software, make sure to back up all you're data.

errors.note: 'you're' should be 'your'; a typo-level grammar slip that does not obscure meaning.

judge_explanation: Instruction is fully understandable and technically accurate; the only flaw is a homophone typo that a proofread would easily catch.

source_text: आपसे अनुरोध है कि कृपया समय पर भुगतान सुनिश्चित करें।
reference_translation: We request that you please ensure timely payment.
candidate_translation: Please make sure to pay on time.

errors.note: Drops the formal 'we request of you' framing, landing closer to a direct instruction than a polite formal request, though still fully polite in English.

judge_explanation: Meaning is fully preserved and the tone is still polite, but it reads slightly more direct/casual than the source's formal business register.

source_text: इस जैकेट में वाटरप्रूफ लाइनिंग, हुड, और दो साइड पॉकेट हैं।
reference_translation: This jacket has a waterproof lining, a hood, and two side pockets.
candidate_translation: This jacket has a waterproof lining and a hood.

errors.note: The 'two side pockets' feature is dropped entirely from a product feature list.

judge_explanation: The translated features that remain are correct, but a full product attribute is missing, which matters in an e-commerce listing where buyers rely on the complete feature list.

source_text: गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने संसद में बयान दिया।
reference_translation: Home Minister Amit Shah gave a statement in Parliament.
candidate_translation: Home Minister Amit Shah gave a statement in the assembly.

errors.note: 'संसद' specifically means 'Parliament' (the national legislature); 'assembly' typically refers to a state legislative assembly (विधानसभा) in Indian political context - a meaningful institutional distinction in a news report.

judge_explanation: The person, action, and rest of the sentence are correct, but substituting 'assembly' for 'Parliament' misidentifies which body the statement was made in, which is a real factual error for a news reader.

source_text: इस फ़ोन की कीमत लगभग 25,000 रुपये है।
reference_translation: This phone costs about 25,000 rupees.
candidate_translation: This phone costs about $25,000.

errors.note: Currency unit changed from Indian rupees to US dollars, inflating the actual price by roughly 300x while keeping the number itself unchanged.

judge_explanation: Sentence structure and fluency are fine, but the currency substitution turns an affordable phone into a wildly expensive one, a critical factual distortion for a price-sensitive e-commerce context.

source_text: यह प्रोडक्ट सिर्फ ऑनलाइन उपलब्ध है और इसे स्टोर में वापस नहीं किया जा सकता, केवल वेबसाइट के ज़रिए रिटर्न संभव है।
reference_translation: This product is only available online and cannot be returned in-store; returns are only possible through the website.
candidate_translation: This product is only available online.

errors.source_span: और इसे स्टोर में वापस नहीं किया जा सकता, केवल वेबसाइट के ज़रिए रिटर्न संभव है
errors.note: The entire return-policy clause is dropped, which is critical, actionable information for a customer, not a minor stylistic detail.

judge_explanation: Only a fragment of the source is translated; a large chunk of policy-critical information is missing entirely, which could directly mislead a customer about how returns work.

source_text: उसने आंखों में धूल झोंक दी।
reference_translation: He pulled the wool over their eyes.
candidate_translation: He threw dust into their eyes.

errors.note: This is a fixed idiom meaning 'to deceive/trick someone'; the literal rendering loses the idiomatic meaning entirely and instead describes a strange, unintended physical act.

judge_explanation: The translation is grammatically valid English but conveys a completely different, nonsensical scenario instead of the intended meaning that someone was deceived - a total loss of meaning for an idiomatic expression.

source_text: The parties agree that this agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delhi.
reference_translation: पक्षकार सहमत हैं कि यह समझौता दिल्ली राज्य के कानूनों द्वारा शासित होगा।
candidate_translation: पक्षकार सहमत हैं कि यह समझौता दिल्ली राज्य के कानूनों द्वारा शासित होगा।
judge_explanation: Accurate, formal legal register throughout; standard legal terminology (पक्षकार, शासित होगा) correctly used.

source_text: The Company shall not be liable for any indirect or consequential damages arising from the use of this product.
reference_translation: कंपनी इस उत्पाद के उपयोग से उत्पन्न किसी भी अप्रत्यक्ष या परिणामी क्षति के लिए उत्तरदायी नहीं होगी।
candidate_translation: कंपनी इस उत्पाद के उपयोग से उत्पन्न किसी भी अप्रत्यक्ष या परिणामी क्षति के लिए उत्तरदायी होगी।

errors.note: The negation 'नहीं' was dropped, turning a liability exclusion clause into its exact opposite: the company IS liable instead of NOT liable.

judge_explanation: A single dropped negation word reverses the legal effect of the entire clause. In a contract, this is a critical, high-stakes error even though the rest of the sentence is fluent and well-formed.

source_text: Take one tablet twice daily after meals with a full glass of water.
reference_translation: भोजन के बाद एक पूरा गिलास पानी के साथ दिन में दो बार एक गोली लें।
candidate_translation: भोजन के बाद एक पूरा गिलास पानी के साथ दिन में दो बार एक गोली लें।
judge_explanation: All dosage details (frequency, timing relative to meals, quantity of water) are accurately and clearly conveyed.

source_text: The recommended dose for adults is 500 mg every 8 hours, not exceeding 1500 mg per day.
reference_translation: वयस्कों के लिए अनुशंसित खुराक हर 8 घंटे में 500 मिलीग्राम है, प्रतिदिन 1500 मिलीग्राम से अधिक नहीं।
candidate_translation: वयस्कों के लिए अनुशंसित खुराक हर 8 घंटे में 50 मिलीग्राम है, प्रतिदिन 1500 मिलीग्राम से अधिक नहीं।

errors.note: A dropped zero changes the per-dose amount from 500mg to 50mg, a 10x understatement of the recommended dose.

judge_explanation: A single-digit numeric error in a dosage instruction is a patient-safety issue, not a stylistic one. This must be scored as unacceptable regardless of how fluent the surrounding sentence is.

source_text: He filed the suit against his neighbor last week.
reference_translation: उसने पिछले हफ्ते अपने पड़ोसी के खिलाफ मुकदमा दायर किया।
candidate_translation: उसने पिछले हफ्ते अपने पड़ोसी के खिलाफ सूट दायर किया।

errors.note: 'suit' here means 'lawsuit' (मुकदमा), disambiguated clearly by 'filed ... against'. The transliteration 'सूट' instead reads as a clothing suit, producing a confusing, near-nonsensical sentence ('filed a clothing-suit against his neighbor').

judge_explanation: The surrounding context ('filed', 'against his neighbor') unambiguously signals the legal sense of 'suit', but the translator picked the wrong sense of this homonym, garbling the meaning of the sentence.

source_text: Thank you for your patience while we resolve this issue.
reference_translation: इस समस्या को हल करते समय आपके धैर्य के लिए धन्यवाद।

errors.note: Translation field is empty; no output was produced at all.

judge_explanation: An empty output is a complete task failure - there is nothing for a Hindi reader to read. A judge must treat this the same as any other total-failure case, not skip or ignore it.

source_text: Please confirm your email address to continue.
reference_translation: कृपया जारी रखने के लिए अपना ईमेल पता की पुष्टि करें।
candidate_translation: कृपया जारी रखने के लिए अपना ईमेल पता कृपया जारी रखने के लिए अपना ईमेल पता कृपया जारी रखने के लिए अपना ईमेल पता की पुष्टि करें।

errors.candidate_span: कृपया जारी रखने के लिए अपना ईमेल पता कृपया जारी रखने के लिए ...
errors.note: The phrase 'कृपया जारी रखने के लिए अपना ईमेल पता' is looped three times before the sentence finally completes - a classic degenerate-generation failure mode.

judge_explanation: Even though the intended message is technically recoverable by a patient reader, this kind of looping output is unusable in any real product surface and must be scored as unacceptable, not merely 'awkward'.

source_text: It's not rocket science, just follow the steps carefully.
reference_translation: यह कोई बहुत मुश्किल काम नहीं है, बस चरणों का ध्यान से पालन करें।
candidate_translation: यह कोई बहुत मुश्किल काम नहीं है, बस चरणों का ध्यान से पालन करें।
judge_explanation: Correctly avoids a literal, nonsensical rendering of 'rocket science' and substitutes a natural Hindi equivalent for 'not difficult'. This is what good sense-for-sense translation looks like and should NOT be penalized for departing from the literal words.

source_text: Open Instagram and tap the camera icon to start a new story.
reference_translation: इंस्टाग्राम खोलें और नई स्टोरी शुरू करने के लिए कैमरा आइकन पर टैप करें।
candidate_translation: इंस्टाग्राम खोलें और नई स्टोरी शुरू करने के लिए कैमरा आइकन पर टैप करें।
judge_explanation: Keeping the brand name (इंस्टाग्राम) and common tech terms (कैमरा, आइकन, टैप, स्टोरी) in their standard transliterated forms matches real-world Hindi tech UI conventions. A judge should NOT penalize this as 'untranslated' or 'over-anglicized' - it is the correct localization choice.

source_text: यह अनुबंध दोनों पक्षों पर बाध्यकारी होगा और किसी भी विवाद की स्थिति में मध्यस्थता के माध्यम से हल किया जाएगा।
reference_translation: This agreement shall be binding on both parties and any dispute shall be resolved through arbitration.
candidate_translation: This agreement shall be binding on both parties and any dispute shall be resolved through arbitration.
judge_explanation: Accurate, standard legal English register; no loss of meaning.

source_text: विक्रेता किसी भी परोक्ष क्षति के लिए उत्तरदायी नहीं होगा।
reference_translation: The seller shall not be liable for any indirect damages.
candidate_translation: The seller shall be liable for any indirect damages.

errors.note: 'नहीं' (not) was dropped, reversing a liability-exclusion clause into a liability-acceptance clause.

judge_explanation: Same failure pattern as its English-to-Hindi counterpart: a dropped negation inverts the legal obligation entirely, which is a critical error regardless of fluency.

source_text: मरीज़ को हर 6 घंटे में 250 मिलीग्राम की खुराक दी जानी चाहिए।
reference_translation: The patient should be given a dose of 250 mg every 6 hours.
candidate_translation: The patient should be given a dose of 250 mg every 6 hours.
judge_explanation: Dosage, frequency, and unit are all accurately preserved.

source_text: गर्भवती महिलाओं को यह दवा नहीं लेनी चाहिए।
reference_translation: Pregnant women should not take this medication.
candidate_translation: Pregnant women should take this medication.

errors.note: Dropping 'नहीं' turns a contraindication warning into an instruction to take the medication - the opposite of the intended safety guidance.

judge_explanation: This is a medical contraindication warning with its polarity reversed. Of every error category in this dataset, this is among the most dangerous in a real-world deployment and must anchor the bottom of the score scale.

source_text: यह आम बात है कि लोग गर्मियों में आम खाना पसंद करते हैं।
reference_translation: It is common that people like to eat mangoes in summer.
candidate_translation: It is a mango thing that people like to eat mango in summer.

errors.note: 'आम' is a homonym meaning both 'common/ordinary' and 'mango'. The first occurrence (meaning 'common') was incorrectly translated as 'mango', producing an incoherent opening clause.

judge_explanation: The second 'आम' (referring to the fruit) is translated correctly, but the first one - which means 'common' - is not, resulting in a sentence that starts out nonsensical despite ending correctly.

source_text: ऑर्डर 03/07/2026 तक डिलीवर हो जाएगा।
reference_translation: The order will be delivered by July 3, 2026.
candidate_translation: The order will be delivered by 03/07/2026.

errors.note: Source uses DD/MM/YYYY (3 July 2026), but the numerals are copied unchanged into English text, where MM/DD/YYYY is the default reading - likely to be misread as March 7, 2026.

judge_explanation: The digits are 'correct' but the format convention isn't localized, so an English reader will very plausibly derive the wrong delivery date - a functionally important error for a commitment date, not just a stylistic one.

source_text: कृपया इस समस्या को हल करने में हमारी सहायता के लिए हमसे संपर्क करें।
reference_translation: Please contact us for assistance in resolving this issue.

errors.note: Empty translation output.

judge_explanation: Complete task failure with no recoverable content; must be scored at the bottom of the scale regardless of source complexity.

source_text: इस योजना के तहत, किसान को हर साल 6,000 रुपये तीन किस्तों में सीधे उनके बैंक खाते में भेजे जाते हैं।
reference_translation: Under this scheme, farmers receive 6,000 rupees every year in three installments, sent directly to their bank account.
candidate_translation: Under this scheme, farmers receive 6,000 rupees every year in three

errors.source_span: तीन किस्तों में सीधे उनके बैंक खाते में भेजे जाते हैं
errors.note: Output cuts off mid-sentence, dropping both 'installments' and the entire bank-transfer mechanism, and ending on a grammatically incomplete fragment.

judge_explanation: The sentence is not just missing detail, it is not even finished - this is a hard truncation failure, not a stylistic omission, and should be scored as unacceptable.

source_text: सर जी, कृपया इस मामले को जल्द से जल्द देखें।
reference_translation: Sir, please look into this matter as soon as possible.
candidate_translation: Hey, look into this ASAP.

errors.note: Drops the respectful address ('सर जी') and the politeness marker ('कृपया'), replacing them with a casual greeting ('Hey') and an abrupt tone ('ASAP') completely unsuited to addressing a superior.

judge_explanation: The core request survives, but the deferential tone appropriate for addressing someone respectfully is entirely lost, which could come across as rude or insubordinate in the target context.

source_text: ट्रांसफार्मर में शॉर्ट सर्किट की वजह से बिजली गुल हो गई।
reference_translation: The power went out because of a short circuit in the transformer.
candidate_translation: The power went out because of a short circuit in the transformer.
judge_explanation: Correctly renders established technical loanwords ('transformer', 'short circuit') as their standard English equivalents rather than forcing an unnatural literal translation. Accurate and idiomatic; should not be penalized for 'sounding too similar' to the source technical terms.

source_text: Please clear the cache and reload the application page.
reference_translation: कृपया कैश को साफ़ करें और एप्लिकेशन पेज को फिर से लोड करें।
candidate_translation: कृपया कैश को साफ़ करें और एप्लिकेशन पेज को फिर से डाउनलोड करें।

errors.note: 'Reload' (फिर से लोड करें / रिफ्रेश करें) is a distinct technical action from 'download again' (फिर से डाउनलोड करें); the instruction now describes the wrong operation.

judge_explanation: The overall intent (refresh the page) is roughly recoverable, but the specific technical action named is incorrect, which matters in a troubleshooting/UI context where precision affects what the user actually does.

source_text: Don't beat around the bush, just spill the beans.
reference_translation: घुमा-फिराकर बात मत करो, सच-सच बता दो।
candidate_translation: झाड़ियों के आसपास मत मारो, बस सेम फैलाओ।

errors.source_span: beat around the bush ... spill the beans
errors.candidate_span: झाड़ियों के आसपास मत मारो, बस सेम फैलाओ
errors.note: Both idioms are translated word-for-word; the result ('don't hit around the bushes, spread the beans') is nonsensical in Hindi and conveys none of the intended meaning.

judge_explanation: Two idioms in a row, both translated literally, produce a sentence with no coherent meaning to a Hindi reader - a total communication failure despite grammatically valid Hindi words.

source_text: The licensee shall not disclose any confidential information to third parties without prior written consent.
reference_translation: लाइसेंसधारी बिना पूर्व लिखित सहमति के किसी भी तीसरे पक्ष को गोपनीय जानकारी का खुलासा नहीं करेगा।
candidate_translation: लाइसेंसधारी बिना पूर्व लिखित सहमति के किसी भी तीसरे पक्ष को गोपनीय जानकारी का खुलासा नहीं करेगा।
judge_explanation: Accurate legal vocabulary (लाइसेंसधारी, पूर्व लिखित सहमति) and correctly preserved negation/obligation structure; formal register matches the genre.

source_text: The patient experienced mild dizziness after taking the medication.
reference_translation: दवा लेने के बाद मरीज को हल्का चक्कर आने का अनुभव हुआ।
candidate_translation: दवा लेने के बाद मरीज को गंभीर चक्कर आने का अनुभव हुआ।

errors.note: 'Mild' (हल्का) is mistranslated as 'severe' (गंभीर), reversing a clinical severity assessment.

judge_explanation: A reversed symptom-severity report in a medical record is a patient-safety-relevant error. This belongs at the bottom of the scale, not merely 'poor'.

source_text: Our state-of-the-art software helps you scale your business seamlessly.
reference_translation: हमारा अत्याधुनिक सॉफ्टवेयर आपके व्यवसाय को बिना किसी परेशानी के बढ़ाने में मदद करता है।
candidate_translation: हमारा अत्याधुनिक सॉफ्टवेयर आपके व्यवसाय को बिना किसी परेशानी के बढ़ाने में मदद करता है।
judge_explanation: 'State-of-the-art' and 'scale seamlessly' are both adapted naturally rather than translated literally, producing fluent, native-sounding marketing copy.

source_text: The government launched a probe into the banking sector scam.
reference_translation: सरकार ने बैंकिंग क्षेत्र के घोटाले की जांच शुरू की।
candidate_translation: सरकार ने बैंकिंग क्षेत्र के घोटाले की जांच शुरू की।
judge_explanation: 'घोटाले की जांच शुरू की' (launched an investigation into the scam) is standard, correct journalistic Hindi; no postposition is missing and no rephrasing is needed.

source_text: The bank was too steep, so they couldn't dock the boat.
reference_translation: किनारा बहुत खड़ा था, इसलिए वे नाव को नहीं लगा सके।
candidate_translation: बैंक बहुत खड़ी थी, इसलिए वे नाव को नहीं लगा सके।

errors.note: 'Bank' here means riverbank (किनारा/तट), signaled by 'dock the boat', but the translator used बैंक (financial institution), which makes no sense with 'too steep' and 'dock a boat'.

judge_explanation: The homonym 'bank' is resolved to the wrong sense despite clear disambiguating context ('dock the boat'), producing a sentence that describes a financial institution being steep - incoherent to a Hindi reader.

source_text: Your subscription will automatically renew on October 15th.
reference_translation: आपकी सदस्यता 15 अक्टूबर को अपने आप नवीनीकृत हो जाएगी।
candidate_translation: आपकी सदस्यता 15 अक्टूबर को अपने आप नवीनीकृत हो जाएगी।
judge_explanation: Accurate and natural; correct date, correct renewal terminology (सदस्यता, नवीनीकृत).

source_text: Enter your password to unlock the device.
reference_translation: डिवाइस को अनलॉक करने के लिए अपना पासवर्ड डालें।
candidate_translation: डिवाइस को अनलॉक करने के लिए अपना पासवर्ड डालें।
judge_explanation: Keeping डिवाइस, पासवर्ड, and अनलॉक in their standard transliterated forms is industry-standard for Hindi tech UI copy and should not be penalized as under-translation.

source_text: This offer is valid only for new users who sign up this week.
reference_translation: यह ऑफ़र केवल उन नए उपयोगकर्ताओं के लिए मान्य है जो इस सप्ताह साइन अप करते हैं।
candidate_translation: यह ऑफ़र केवल नए उपयोगकर्ताओं के लिए मान्य है।

errors.note: The time-bound qualifying clause is dropped entirely, making the offer appear open-ended instead of limited to sign-ups this week.

judge_explanation: Dropping the qualifying condition changes the actual terms of the offer as understood by the reader - a business-relevant omission, not just missing color.

source_text: Please return the keys to the front desk before checking out.
reference_translation: कृपया चेक आउट करने से पहले चाबियां फ्रंट डेस्क पर लौटा दें।
candidate_translation: कृपया चेक आउट करने से पहले चाबियां फ्रंट डेस्क पर लौटा दें और अपना सुरक्षा रिफंड प्राप्त करें।

errors.candidate_span: और अपना सुरक्षा रिफंड प्राप्त करें
errors.note: Adds 'and receive your security refund', a claim not present anywhere in the source, which could set an incorrect expectation for the guest.

judge_explanation: The core instruction is translated correctly, but fabricated additional information about a refund is appended - exactly the kind of unsupported addition a judge should flag and penalize even when it sounds plausible.

source_text: मुझे थोड़ी देर हो जाएगी, तुम शुरू कर दो।
reference_translation: I'll be a little late, go ahead and start.
candidate_translation: I will get a little late, you start.

errors.candidate_span: I will get a little late
errors.note: 'Get late' is a direct calque of the Hindi construction (देर होना) and reads as non-native English, though it is fully understandable.

judge_explanation: Meaning is entirely clear and the casual tone matches the source, but the phrasing is a recognizable Hindi-to-English calque rather than natural English.

source_text: वह बेवजह हर बात में अपनी टांग अड़ा रहा था।
reference_translation: He was meddling/interfering in everything for no reason.
candidate_translation: He was sticking his leg into everything for no reason.

errors.note: 'टांग अड़ाना' is a fixed idiom meaning 'to meddle/interfere'; the literal rendering produces a bizarre physical image with no connection to the intended meaning.

judge_explanation: Grammatically valid English, but conveys a completely different (and nonsensical) scenario instead of the intended meaning that someone was interfering unnecessarily.

source_text: हमारा ऐप आपकी रोज़मर्रा की ज़िंदगी को आसान बनाने के लिए बनाया गया है।
reference_translation: Our app is designed to make your everyday life easier.
candidate_translation: Our app is designed to make your everyday life easier.
judge_explanation: 'रोज़मर्रा की ज़िंदगी को आसान बनाने' (make everyday life easier) is rendered naturally and idiomatically as 'make your everyday life easier', preserving the marketing tone with no loss of meaning.

source_text: अगर आपको कोई समस्या हो, तो कृपया 24/7 हमारी सहायता टीम से संपर्क करें।
reference_translation: If you have any issues, please contact our support team, available 24/7.
candidate_translation: If you have any issues, please contact our support team, available 24/7.
judge_explanation: Accurate and natural; correctly restructures the sentence so '24/7' reads fluently in English rather than following the Hindi word order literally.

source_text: चेक-इन दोपहर 2 बजे से शुरू होता है और चेक-आउट सुबह 11 बजे तक है, नाश्ता कमरे के किराए में शामिल है।
reference_translation: Check-in starts at 2 PM and check-out is by 11 AM, with breakfast included in the room rate.
candidate_translation: Check-in starts at 2 PM and check-out is by 11 AM.

errors.source_span: नाश्ता कमरे के किराए में शामिल है
errors.note: Drops the fact that breakfast is included in the room rate - a concrete guest-facing benefit, not incidental detail.

judge_explanation: Timing details are accurate, but an entire amenity/inclusion fact is missing, which could lead a guest to expect it isn't included.

source_text: अरे यार, मैंने वो फाइल कहीं रख के भूल गया, थोड़ा ढूंढ के बता।
reference_translation: Hey man, I put that file somewhere and forgot where - can you look for it and let me know?
candidate_translation: Hey man, I kept that file somewhere and forgot, find and tell a little.

errors.note: Word-for-word calque of the Hindi request construction; 'find and tell a little' is not natural English and requires effort to parse back into 'please look for it and let me know'.

judge_explanation: The casual tone and core request are recoverable, but the ending is awkward enough that a native English reader would need to reread it to get the intended meaning.

source_text: ऐप को इंस्टॉल करने के बाद, अपने अकाउंट में लॉगिन करें और सेटिंग्स को कॉन्फ़िगर करें।
reference_translation: After installing the app, log in to your account and configure the settings.
candidate_translation: After install the app, log in to your account and configure the settings.

errors.note: 'After install' should be 'After installing' - a small grammatical slip that doesn't affect comprehension of the instruction sequence.

judge_explanation: All three steps and their order are accurately conveyed; the only flaw is a minor verb-form error at the start.

source_text: चुनाव आयोग ने अगले महीने राज्य में मतदान की तारीखों की घोषणा की।
reference_translation: The Election Commission announced polling dates in the state next month.
candidate_translation: The Election Commission announced polling dates in the country next month.

errors.note: 'राज्य' means 'state', not 'country'; this changes the scope of the news item from a state-level election to a national one, a real factual distortion in a news report.

judge_explanation: Everything else is accurate, but conflating 'state' with 'country' misrepresents the scale and jurisdiction of the election being reported on.

source_text: इस समझौते में किसी भी संशोधन के लिए दोनों पक्षों की लिखित सहमति आवश्यक होगी।
reference_translation: Any amendment to this agreement will require the written consent of both parties.
candidate_translation: Any amendment to this agreement will require consent of both parties.

errors.note: Drops 'written' (लिखित), removing a specific evidentiary requirement from a legal clause - verbal consent would now appear to satisfy the requirement, which is not what the source states.

judge_explanation: The requirement for both parties' agreement is preserved, but a specific legal qualifier (that consent must be in writing) is silently dropped, which matters in a contract.

source_text: यह दवा खाली पेट नहीं लेनी चाहिए, इसे भोजन के साथ लें।
reference_translation: This medicine should not be taken on an empty stomach; take it with food.
candidate_translation: This medicine should be taken with food.

errors.note: The explicit warning against taking the medicine on an empty stomach is dropped; the positive instruction ('take with food') implies it but does not state the warning directly.

judge_explanation: The practical guidance a patient needs (take with food) still comes through, but the explicit contraindication is missing, which is a meaningful gap for a medical instruction even though it's not a full reversal.

source_text: मुझे थोड़ा टेंशन हो रहा है इंटरव्यू को लेकर।
reference_translation: I'm a bit stressed about the interview.
candidate_translation: I'm a bit stressed about the interview.
judge_explanation: 'टेंशन' is a colloquial Hindi loanword that idiomatically means 'stress/anxiety' rather than literal physical 'tension'; translating it as 'stressed' captures the actual meaning correctly. A judge should NOT penalize this for not matching the English loanword literally - the sense-based choice is the correct one.

source_text: The central bank raised interest rates by 25 basis points on Thursday.
reference_translation: 央行周四将利率上调了25个基点。
candidate_translation: 央行周四将利率上调了25个基点。
judge_explanation: Accurate and fluent; correct financial terminology (基点) and appropriate formal news register.

source_text: The city's population grew to 12 million over the past decade.
reference_translation: 过去十年,这座城市的人口增长到了1200万。
candidate_translation: 过去十年,这座城市的人口增长到了120万。

errors.note: 120万 = 1.2 million, not 12 million. Correct conversion is 1200万 (万 = ten-thousand, so 1200 x 10,000 = 12,000,000).

judge_explanation: A classic 万-scale conversion slip understates the population by a factor of 10, a significant factual error in a news statistic.

source_text: The government has not approved the merger between the two telecom companies.
reference_translation: 政府尚未批准两家电信公司之间的合并。
candidate_translation: 政府已经批准了两家电信公司之间的合并。

errors.note: Dropped negation reverses the entire fact: 'has not approved' becomes 'has already approved'.

judge_explanation: Fluent, well-formed Chinese that reports the exact opposite of the source fact - a critical reversal in a news context.

source_text: This agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Singapore.
reference_translation: 本协议应受新加坡法律管辖并据其解释。
candidate_translation: 本协议应受新加坡法律管辖并据其解释。
judge_explanation: Standard, accurate legal Chinese with correct governing-law clause phrasing.

source_text: The Contractor shall not subcontract any part of this Agreement without the prior written consent of the Client.
reference_translation: 未经客户事先书面同意,承包商不得将本协议的任何部分分包出去。
candidate_translation: 承包商可以在未经客户事先书面同意的情况下将本协议的任何部分分包出去。

errors.source_span: shall not subcontract ... without the prior written consent
errors.candidate_span: 可以在未经...同意的情况下...分包出去
errors.note: 'Shall not ... without consent' is rendered as 'may ... without consent', turning a restriction into an explicit permission for exactly the unauthorized action the clause was meant to prevent.

judge_explanation: This is a total reversal of a contractual restriction, granting the contractor a right the source explicitly denies - a critical legal error despite fluent Chinese.

source_text: Take one capsule every 12 hours with food.
reference_translation: 每12小时随餐服用一粒胶囊。
candidate_translation: 每12小时随餐服用一粒胶囊。
judge_explanation: All dosage details (frequency, food timing, quantity) accurately conveyed with correct measure word (粒 for capsules).

source_text: The maximum daily dose is 3000 mg; do not exceed 6 tablets in 24 hours.
reference_translation: 每日最大剂量为3000毫克;24小时内不要超过6片。
candidate_translation: 每日最大剂量为300毫克;24小时内不要超过6片。

errors.note: A dropped zero understates the maximum daily dose by 10x.

judge_explanation: A single-digit numeric slip in a dosage limit is a patient-safety issue and must be scored as unacceptable regardless of fluency.

source_text: This medication may cause drowsiness; avoid driving or operating heavy machinery.
reference_translation: 这种药物可能会导致嗜睡;请勿驾驶或操作重型机械。
candidate_translation: 这种药物可能会导致嗜睡。

errors.source_span: avoid driving or operating heavy machinery
errors.note: The actionable safety instruction is dropped entirely, leaving only the symptom description.

judge_explanation: The side-effect is conveyed, but the practical safety guidance a patient needs to act on is missing - a meaningful gap for a medication label.

source_text: This laptop features a 15-inch display, 16GB RAM, and a 512GB SSD.
reference_translation: 这款笔记本电脑配备15英寸显示屏、16GB内存和512GB固态硬盘。
candidate_translation: 这款笔记本电脑配备15英寸显示屏、16GB内存和512GB固态硬盘。
judge_explanation: All specs accurately translated with correct standard technical terminology.

source_text: The package includes the main unit, a charging cable, a user manual, and a 1-year warranty card.
reference_translation: 包装内含主机、充电线、使用说明书和一年保修卡。
candidate_translation: 包装内含主机、充电线和使用说明书。

errors.note: One of four listed package contents (the warranty card) is dropped.

judge_explanation: Most package contents are correctly listed, but a distinct item - the warranty card - is missing, which matters for a product listing where buyers rely on the full contents list.

source_text: The smartwatch is priced at $199.99, a 20% discount from the original price.
reference_translation: 这款智能手表售价199.99美元,是原价的8折。
candidate_translation: 这款智能手表售价199.99元,是原价的8折。

errors.note: '$' (US dollars) is rendered as 元 (RMB/yuan) without clarification, presenting a US-dollar price as if it were an RMB price - roughly a 7x understatement of actual cost for a Chinese reader.

judge_explanation: The number and discount percentage are correct, but the currency substitution meaningfully misrepresents the real price.

source_text: Restart your computer and check if the issue persists.
reference_translation: 重启电脑,检查问题是否仍然存在。
candidate_translation: 重启电脑,检查问题是否仍然存在。
judge_explanation: 'Restart your computer and check if the issue persists' is rendered completely and naturally as '重启电脑,检查问题是否仍然存在' - both actions are preserved with no loss of meaning.

source_text: Clear your browser cache and reload the page.
reference_translation: 清除你的浏览器缓存并重新加载页面。
candidate_translation: 清除你的浏览器缓存并重新下载页面。

errors.note: 'Reload' (重新加载 / 刷新) is mistranslated as 'redownload' (重新下载), a distinct technical action.

judge_explanation: The overall intent (refresh the page) is roughly recoverable, but the specific action named is technically incorrect.

source_text: Hey, are you free this weekend? Let's grab coffee.
reference_translation: 嘿,你这个周末有空吗?我们去喝杯咖啡吧。
candidate_translation: 嘿,你这个周末有空吗?我们去喝杯咖啡吧。
judge_explanation: Natural, colloquial Mandarin matching the casual tone and intent of the source exactly.

source_text: Can you send me the updated file by tomorrow morning?
reference_translation: 你能在明天早上之前把更新后的文件发给我吗?
candidate_translation: Can you send me the updated file by tomorrow morning?

errors.source_span: Can you send me the updated file by tomorrow morning?
errors.candidate_span: Can you send me the updated file by tomorrow morning?
errors.note: Output is identical to the source; no translation occurred.

judge_explanation: A complete task failure - a Chinese-only reader gets zero value from this output.

source_text: I might be a bit late, something came up.
reference_translation: 我可能会晚一点,有点事情。
candidate_translation: 我可能会晚一点,家里出了点急事,可能要处理一下。

errors.candidate_span: 家里出了点急事,可能要处理一下
errors.note: Fabricates a specific reason ('an urgent family matter needs handling') not present in or implied by the vague source phrase.

judge_explanation: The translator invented specific unsupported details, changing what the speaker is understood to have actually said.

source_text: We regret to inform you that your application has not been successful on this occasion.
reference_translation: 很遗憾地通知您,您此次的申请未能成功。
candidate_translation: 很遗憾地通知您,您此次的申请未能成功。
judge_explanation: Accurate and appropriately formal, preserving both the apologetic tone and the respectful 您 address.

source_text: Please find attached the invoice for your recent purchase.
reference_translation: 您近期购买的发票已附上,请查收。
candidate_translation: 你的发票在附件里,自己看看。

errors.note: Drops the respectful 您 for casual 你, and '自己看看' ('take a look yourself') reads as curt/dismissive rather than the polite '请查收' expected in business correspondence.

judge_explanation: The factual content survives, but the tone is inappropriately blunt for a formal business email and could come across as rude to the recipient.

source_text: We would appreciate it if you could confirm your attendance by Friday.
reference_translation: 如果您能在周五之前确认出席,我们将不胜感激。
candidate_translation: 如果你能在周五之前确认出席,我们将不胜感激。

errors.note: Uses casual 你 instead of the formal/polite 您 in an otherwise formally-phrased request.

judge_explanation: Meaning and overall politeness are preserved (不胜感激 is still very formal), but the pronoun choice is a small, noticeable register slip.

source_text: It's raining cats and dogs outside, don't forget your umbrella.
reference_translation: 外面下着倾盆大雨,别忘了带伞。
candidate_translation: 外面在下猫和狗,别忘了带伞。

errors.note: Word-for-word rendering of the English idiom produces a surreal, meaningless image in Chinese instead of the intended 'heavy rain'.

judge_explanation: Grammatically valid Chinese that a native reader would find genuinely confusing, since 'raining cats and dogs' has no equivalent literal meaning in Chinese.

source_text: Don't cry over spilled milk, just move on.
reference_translation: 覆水难收,别再纠结了,往前看吧。
candidate_translation: 不要为打翻的牛奶哭泣,继续前进吧。

errors.note: The literal rendering is comprehensible to a Chinese reader but misses the natural chengyu equivalent 覆水难收 ('spilled water is hard to retrieve'), reading as translated rather than native.

judge_explanation: The meaning comes through and the sentence isn't broken, but a more idiomatic native reader would immediately notice this doesn't sound like naturally-written Chinese.

source_text: The bank was too steep, so they couldn't dock the boat.
reference_translation: 河岸太陡峭了,所以他们无法停靠船。
candidate_translation: 银行太陡峭了,所以他们无法停靠船。

errors.note: 'Bank' here means riverbank (河岸/岸边), signaled by 'dock the boat', but is translated as 银行 (financial institution), producing an incoherent sentence about a steep bank building.

judge_explanation: The disambiguating context ('dock the boat') clearly points to riverbank, but the wrong sense was chosen, garbling the sentence.

candidate_translation: El gobierno ha aprobado la fusión entre las dos aerolíneas.

errors.note: The negation 'no' is dropped, reversing the reported fact from 'has not approved' to 'has approved'.

judge_explanation: Fluent, well-formed Spanish that reports the exact opposite of the source fact - a critical reversal in a news item about a pending merger.

source_text: La inflación anual se situó en el 3,2 % en agosto.
reference_translation: Annual inflation stood at 3.2% in August.
candidate_translation: Annual inflation stood at 3.2% in August.
judge_explanation: Accurate; correctly converts the Spanish decimal comma (3,2 %) to the English decimal point (3.2%).

source_text: El desempleo bajó al 5,8 % el mes pasado.
reference_translation: Unemployment fell to 5.8% last month.
candidate_translation: Unemployment fell to 8.5% last month.

errors.note: Digits are transposed: source is 5.8%, candidate reports 8.5%, a materially different unemployment figure.

judge_explanation: The digits of the unemployment rate are transposed (5.8% -> 8.5%), a critical numeric error in an economic news statistic that a reader would take at face value.

source_text: Hey, are you free this weekend? Let's grab a coffee.
reference_translation: Oye, ¿estás libre este fin de semana? Vamos a tomar un café.
candidate_translation: Oye, ¿estás libre este fin de semana? Vamos a tomar un café.
judge_explanation: Natural, colloquial Spanish that matches the casual tone and phrasing of the source.

source_text: Está lloviendo a cántaros, no olvides el paraguas.
reference_translation: It's pouring rain, don't forget your umbrella.
candidate_translation: It's pouring rain, don't forget your umbrella.
judge_explanation: Correctly renders the idiom 'lloviendo a cántaros' (literally 'raining jugfuls') as the natural English idiom 'pouring rain' rather than a nonsensical literal translation. This is what good sense-for-sense translation looks like.

source_text: I can't make it tonight, something came up.
reference_translation: No puedo ir esta noche, surgió algo.
candidate_translation: No puedo ir esta noche, tengo una emergencia médica muy grave.

errors.candidate_span: tengo una emergencia médica muy grave
errors.note: Fabricates a specific 'serious medical emergency' that is not present in or implied by the vague source phrase 'something came up'.

judge_explanation: The translator invents a specific, alarming reason not present in the source, changing what the speaker is understood to have actually said.

source_text: Oye tío, ¡menuda fiesta la de anoche!
reference_translation: Hey dude, what a party last night!
candidate_translation: Hello sir, that was quite a gathering last night.

errors.note: 'Oye tío' (informal, 'hey dude') is rendered as 'Hello sir', a jarring formality mismatch for a casual exclamation among friends.

judge_explanation: The gist survives, but the wildly formal register ('Hello sir', 'gathering') completely misrepresents the casual, excited tone of the Spanish original.

source_text: Can you send me the updated file by tomorrow morning?
reference_translation: ¿Puedes enviarme el archivo actualizado para mañana por la mañana?
candidate_translation: ¿Puedes enviarme el archivo actualizado para mañana por la mañana?
judge_explanation: Accurate and natural informal request, correctly using tú register consistent with a casual exchange.

source_text: Restart the router and wait for the lights to turn green before reconnecting.
reference_translation: Reinicia el router y espera a que las luces se pongan verdes antes de volver a conectar.
candidate_translation: Reinicia el router y espera a que las luces se pongan verdes antes de volver a conectar.
judge_explanation: 'Restart the router and wait for the lights to turn green before reconnecting' is rendered completely and naturally as 'Reinicia el router y espera a que las luces se pongan verdes antes de volver a conectar' - all three steps are preserved.

source_text: Clear your browser cache and reload the page.
reference_translation: Borra la caché del navegador y vuelve a cargar la página.
candidate_translation: Borra la caché del navegador y vuelve a descargar la página.

errors.note: 'Reload' (volver a cargar / refrescar) is mistranslated as 'redownload' (volver a descargar), a distinct technical action.

judge_explanation: The overall intent is roughly recoverable, but the specific technical action named is incorrect - reloading and redownloading are different operations.

source_text: La aplicación móvil se actualizó automáticamente anoche.
reference_translation: The mobile app updated automatically last night.
candidate_translation: The mobile app updated automatically last night.
judge_explanation: 'La aplicación móvil se actualizó automáticamente anoche' is rendered completely and accurately as 'The mobile app updated automatically last night' - subject, tense, and the automatic/last-night details are all preserved.

source_text: Back up your files before installing the new firmware.
reference_translation: Haz una copia de seguridad de tus archivos antes de instalar el nuevo firmware.
candidate_translation: Haz una copia de tus archivos antes de instalar el nuevo firmware.

errors.note: 'Copia de seguridad' (backup) is shortened to 'copia' (copy), losing the specific technical meaning of a safety backup versus a generic file copy.

judge_explanation: The instruction is still followable, but 'copia' alone is a less precise technical term than 'copia de seguridad', slightly diluting the safety intent of the instruction.

source_text: We regret to inform you that your application has not been shortlisted for the next round.

candidate_translation: Lamentamos informarle de que su solicitud no ha sido preseleccionada para la siguiente ronda.

source_text: This blender comes with a 2-year warranty, three speed settings, and a free recipe book.

candidate_translation: Esta batidora incluye una garantía de 2 años, tres velocidades y un libro de recetas gratis.

source_text: This blender comes with a 2-year warranty, three speed settings, and a free recipe book.

source_text: The smartwatch is priced at $199.99, a 20% discount from the original price.

candidate_translation: El reloj inteligente cuesta 199,99 €, un 20 % de descuento sobre el precio original.

errors.note: The currency symbol is changed from US dollars ($) to euros (€) without conversion, misrepresenting the actual price for a euro-zone reader.

judge_explanation: The number and discount percentage are correct, but silently swapping the currency symbol misrepresents the real price a customer would pay.

source_text: Este producto solo está disponible en línea y no se puede devolver en tienda.
reference_translation: This product is only available online and cannot be returned in-store.
candidate_translation: This product is only available online and cannot be returned in-store.
judge_explanation: Accurate and complete; both policy facts (online-only, no in-store returns) are preserved.

source_text: I don't think I can make it tonight, something came up.
reference_translation: Creo que no voy a poder ir esta noche, surgió algo.
candidate_translation: Creo que no voy a poder ir esta noche, tengo una reunión de trabajo urgente.

errors.candidate_span: tengo una reunión de trabajo urgente
errors.note: Fabricates a specific 'urgent work meeting' not present in or implied by the vague source phrase.

judge_explanation: The vague 'something came up' is replaced with a fabricated specific - 'tengo una reunión de trabajo urgente' (I have an urgent work meeting) - which changes what the speaker is understood to have actually said, a fidelity error even though the line reads naturally.

source_text: No puedo creer que hayas hecho eso sin decirme nada.
reference_translation: I can't believe you did that without telling me.
candidate_translation: I can't believe you did that without telling me.
judge_explanation: Accurate, natural English that preserves the subjunctive-driven reproach of the Spanish original.

source_text: Don't cry over spilled milk, just move on.
reference_translation: A lo hecho, pecho; no te quedes lamentando y sigue adelante.
candidate_translation: No llores sobre la leche derramada, solo sigue adelante.

errors.candidate_span: No llores sobre la leche derramada
errors.note: The literal rendering is comprehensible to a Spanish reader but misses the natural Spanish equivalent 'a lo hecho, pecho', reading as translated rather than native.

judge_explanation: Comprehensible to a Spanish reader and not outright wrong, but this is a near-literal calque rather than the more natural Spanish idiom ('a lo hecho, pecho'); a fluent native speaker would notice it reads as translated.

source_text: Se le fue el santo al cielo y se olvidó por completo de la reunión.
reference_translation: It completely slipped his mind and he forgot all about the meeting.
candidate_translation: It completely slipped his mind and he forgot all about the meeting.
judge_explanation: Correctly renders the idiom 'se le fue el santo al cielo' (literally 'his saint went to heaven') as the natural English idiom 'it slipped his mind' rather than a nonsensical literal translation.

source_text: The parties agree that this agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of California.
reference_translation: Las partes acuerdan que el presente contrato se regirá por las leyes del Estado de California.
candidate_translation: Las partes acuerdan que el presente contrato se regirá por las leyes del Estado de California.
judge_explanation: The governing-law clause is rendered with correct legal register throughout: 'shall be governed by the laws of the State of California' -> 'se regirá por las leyes del Estado de California', with no hedging or informality introduced.

source_text: The Company shall not be liable for any indirect or consequential damages.
reference_translation: La Empresa no será responsable de daños indirectos o consecuentes.
candidate_translation: La Empresa será responsable de daños indirectos o consecuentes.

errors.note: The negation 'no' is dropped, reversing a liability-exclusion clause into a liability-acceptance clause.

judge_explanation: A single dropped negation reverses the legal effect of the entire clause - a critical, high-stakes error in a contract despite fluent surrounding Spanish.

source_text: El arrendatario deberá pagar la fianza antes de la firma del contrato.
reference_translation: The tenant must pay the deposit before signing the contract.
candidate_translation: The tenant must pay the deposit before signing the contract.
judge_explanation: Accurate legal English with correct standard terminology (deposit, signing).

source_text: El contrato podrá rescindirse por incumplimiento, previa notificación por escrito con 30 días de antelación.
reference_translation: The contract may be terminated for breach, with 30 days' prior written notice.
candidate_translation: The contract may be terminated for breach.

errors.source_span: previa notificación por escrito con 30 días de antelación
errors.note: The entire notice-period requirement ('30 días de antelación por escrito') is dropped, a legally material condition for termination.

judge_explanation: The right to terminate is preserved, but the specific written-notice requirement is missing entirely, which matters for a clause governing how termination must actually be carried out.

source_text: Take one tablet twice daily after meals with a full glass of water.
reference_translation: Tome una tableta dos veces al día después de las comidas con un vaso lleno de agua.
candidate_translation: Tome una tableta dos veces al día después de las comidas con un vaso lleno de agua.
judge_explanation: All dosage details (frequency, timing, quantity of water) accurately and clearly conveyed.

source_text: The recommended dose for adults is 500 mg every 8 hours, not exceeding 1500 mg per day.
reference_translation: La dosis recomendada para adultos es de 500 mg cada 8 horas, sin superar los 1500 mg al día.
candidate_translation: La dosis recomendada para adultos es de 50 mg cada 8 horas, sin superar los 1500 mg al día.

errors.note: A dropped zero changes the per-dose amount from 500 mg to 50 mg, a 10x understatement of the recommended dose.

judge_explanation: A single-digit numeric error in a dosage instruction is a patient-safety issue and must be scored as unacceptable regardless of the fluency of the rest of the sentence.

source_text: El paciente presenta fiebre leve y dolor de garganta.
reference_translation: The patient has a mild fever and sore throat.
candidate_translation: The patient has a mild fever and sore throat.
judge_explanation: 'Fiebre leve y dolor de garganta' is rendered precisely as 'a mild fever and sore throat', preserving both the severity qualifier ('mild', not just 'fever') and the second symptom exactly.

source_text: Las mujeres embarazadas no deben tomar este medicamento.
reference_translation: Pregnant women should not take this medication.
candidate_translation: Pregnant women should take this medication.

errors.note: Dropping 'no' turns a contraindication warning into an instruction to take the medication - the opposite of the intended safety guidance.

judge_explanation: This is a medical contraindication warning with its polarity reversed - among the most dangerous error categories in a real-world deployment.

source_text: Our state-of-the-art software helps you scale your business seamlessly.
reference_translation: Nuestro software de vanguardia le ayuda a escalar su negocio sin complicaciones.
candidate_translation: Nuestro software de vanguardia le ayuda a escalar su negocio sin complicaciones.
judge_explanation: 'State-of-the-art' and 'seamlessly' are both adapted naturally rather than translated literally, producing fluent native-sounding marketing copy.

source_text: We are excited to announce our new range of products.
reference_translation: Nos complace anunciar nuestra nueva gama de productos.
candidate_translation: Estamos embarazados de anunciar nuestra nueva gama de productos.

errors.note: Classic false-friend error: 'excited' is mistranslated as 'embarazada/o' (pregnant) instead of 'emocionado/a' or 'nos complace'; the sentence now claims the company is pregnant.

judge_explanation: A textbook false-friend mistake (excited -> embarazado/pregnant) turns professional marketing copy into a nonsensical and unintentionally comic claim.

source_text: Nuestra aplicación está diseñada para simplificar tu vida diaria.
reference_translation: Our app is designed to simplify your everyday life.
candidate_translation: Our app is designed to simplify your everyday life.
judge_explanation: 'Simplificar tu vida diaria' (simplify your daily life) is rendered naturally as 'simplify your everyday life', preserving the marketing register with no loss of meaning.

source_text: Your subscription will automatically renew on October 15th.
reference_translation: Su suscripción se renovará automáticamente el 15 de octubre.
candidate_translation: Su suscripción se renovará automáticamente el 15 de octubre.
judge_explanation: The renewal date is preserved exactly: 'October 15th' -> 'el 15 de octubre', with 'automatically renew' correctly rendered as 'se renovará automáticamente'.

source_text: The order will be delivered by 03/07/2026.
reference_translation: El pedido se entregará antes del 7 de marzo de 2026.
candidate_translation: El pedido se entregará antes del 03/07/2026.

errors.note: Source uses US MM/DD/YYYY (March 7); the digits are copied unchanged into Spanish text, where DD/MM/YYYY is standard - a Spanish reader would read this as 3 July, not 7 March.

judge_explanation: The digits are 'correct' but the date-format convention isn't localized, so a Spanish reader will very plausibly derive the wrong delivery date.

source_text: Necesitamos que confirme su dirección de correo electrónico para continuar.
reference_translation: We need you to confirm your email address to continue.
candidate_translation: we need u to confirm ur email to continue

errors.note: Formal notice ('Necesitamos que confirme...su') is rendered in texting-style abbreviations ('u', 'ur') and no capitalization, wholly inappropriate for an official account notice.

judge_explanation: The content is decodable, but the formal notice 'Necesitamos que confirme su dirección de correo electrónico' is rendered as lowercase texting-speak 'we need u to confirm ur email to continue' - jarringly unprofessional for an official account notice.

candidate_translation: El vuelo se retrasó debido a un problema de programación de la tripulación.

candidate_translation: No toque el vidrio roto con las manos desnudas.

source_text: Do not touch the broken glass with bare hands.

reference_translation: Wear safety goggles when cutting metal.
candidate_translation: Wear safety goggles when cutting metal.
judge_explanation: 'Use gafas de protección al cortar metal' is rendered precisely as 'Wear safety goggles when cutting metal' - the equipment, the hazard, and the imperative register are all preserved.

source_text: The bank was too steep, so they couldn't dock the boat.
reference_translation: La orilla era demasiado empinada, así que no pudieron atracar el barco.
candidate_translation: El banco era demasiado empinado, así que no pudieron atracar el barco.

errors.note: 'Bank' here means riverbank (orilla), signaled by 'dock the boat', but is translated as 'banco' (financial bank), producing an incoherent sentence about a steep financial institution.

judge_explanation: The disambiguating context ('dock the boat') clearly points to riverbank, but the wrong sense of the homonym was chosen, garbling the sentence.

source_text: Como no vino, brindamos con vino.
reference_translation: Since he didn't come, we toasted with wine.
candidate_translation: Since he didn't wine, we toasted with wine.

errors.note: The first 'vino' (from venir, 'he came') is mistranslated as the noun 'wine' instead of the verb 'came', producing an ungrammatical, nonsensical clause.

judge_explanation: This Spanish sentence plays on 'vino' meaning both 'he came' and 'wine'; the candidate picks the wrong sense for the first occurrence, breaking both grammar and meaning.

source_text: He filed the suit against his neighbor last week.
reference_translation: La semana pasada presentó una demanda contra su vecino.
candidate_translation: La semana pasada presentó una demanda contra su vecino.
judge_explanation: Correctly resolves the homonym 'suit' as 'demanda' (lawsuit) rather than 'traje' (clothing suit), using the disambiguating context 'filed...against his neighbor' accurately.

source_text: The girl wrote a long letter to her mother.
reference_translation: La niña escribió una carta larga a su madre.
candidate_translation: La niña escribió una carta largo a su madre.

errors.note: 'Largo' (masculine) should be 'larga' to agree with the feminine noun 'carta'.

judge_explanation: Meaning is completely clear, but this adjective-noun gender agreement mistake is immediately noticeable as 'wrong Spanish' to a native speaker.

source_text: I bought three red chairs.

candidate_translation: Compré tres sillas rojo.

errors.note: 'Rojo' (masculine singular) should be 'rojas' to agree with the feminine plural noun 'sillas' in both gender and number.

judge_explanation: A double agreement failure (gender and number) makes this read as clearly non-native Spanish, though the meaning remains recoverable.

judge_explanation: 'Los estudiantes terminaron sus exámenes' is rendered as 'The students finished their exams' with correct plural agreement throughout - 'students', 'their', and 'exams' are all consistently plural, matching the source.

errors.note: Translation field is empty; no output was produced at all.

candidate_translation: Abre Instagram y toca el icono de la cámara para empezar una nueva historia.
judge_explanation: Keeping the brand name 'Instagram' untranslated matches real-world Spanish tech UI conventions; should NOT be penalized as 'untranslated'.

source_text: It's not rocket science, just follow the steps carefully.
reference_translation: No es tan difícil, solo sigue los pasos con cuidado.
candidate_translation: No es tan difícil, solo sigue los pasos con cuidado.

source_text: Ese plan está buenísimo, ¡vamos con todo!
reference_translation: That plan sounds great, let's go all in!
candidate_translation: That plan sounds great, let's go all in!
judge_explanation: Correctly captures the colloquial intensifier 'buenísimo' and the idiom 'vamos con todo' with natural English equivalents rather than over-literal translation.

source_text: Sir, we appreciate your continued loyalty to our service.
reference_translation: Señor, agradecemos su fidelidad continua a nuestro servicio.
candidate_translation: Señor, agradecemos su fidelidad continua a nuestro servicio.
judge_explanation: Correctly matches the formal usted register of the English 'Sir' address; should not be penalized for formality that fits the context.

source_text: Reinicia el servicio de la base de datos después de instalar la actualización.
reference_translation: Restart the database service after installing the update.
candidate_translation: Restart the database service after downloading the update.

errors.note: 'Instalar' (install) is mistranslated as 'downloading', a distinct and earlier step than installation.

judge_explanation: The sentence is fluent, but names the wrong step of the process (downloading vs. installing), which could lead someone to restart before the update is actually applied.

source_text: The central bank raised interest rates by 25 basis points on Thursday.
reference_translation: La banque centrale a relevé ses taux d'intérêt de 25 points de base jeudi.
candidate_translation: La banque centrale a relevé ses taux d'intérêt de 25 points de base jeudi.
judge_explanation: Accurate and fluent; correct financial terminology (points de base) and formal news register.

source_text: The government has not approved the merger between the two airlines.

candidate_translation: Le gouvernement a approuvé la fusion entre les deux compagnies aériennes.

errors.note: The negation 'n'...pas' is dropped entirely, reversing the reported fact.

judge_explanation: Fluent, well-formed French that reports the exact opposite of the source fact - a critical reversal in a news item about a pending merger.

source_text: L'inflation annuelle s'est établie à 3,2 % en août.
reference_translation: Annual inflation stood at 3.2% in August.
candidate_translation: Annual inflation stood at 3.2% in August.
judge_explanation: Accurate; correctly converts the French decimal comma to the English decimal point.

source_text: Le chômage est tombé à 5,8 % le mois dernier.
reference_translation: Unemployment fell to 5.8% last month.
candidate_translation: Unemployment fell to 8.5% last month.

errors.note: Digits transposed: source is 5.8%, candidate reports 8.5%.

judge_explanation: '5,8 %' in the French source is transposed to '8.5%' in the candidate - a critical, materially wrong figure for an economic statistic, not a rounding or formatting difference.

source_text: Hey, are you free this weekend? Let's grab a coffee.
reference_translation: Salut, t'es libre ce week-end ? On va prendre un café ?
candidate_translation: Salut, t'es libre ce week-end ? On va prendre un café ?
judge_explanation: Natural, colloquial French (tu register, elided 't'es') matching the casual tone of the source.

source_text: Il pleut des cordes, n'oublie pas ton parapluie.
reference_translation: It's raining cats and dogs, don't forget your umbrella.
candidate_translation: It's raining ropes, don't forget your umbrella.

errors.note: 'Pleuvoir des cordes' is a fixed idiom for heavy rain; the literal rendering 'raining ropes' is nonsensical in English.

judge_explanation: The literal, word-for-word rendering of this weather idiom produces a strange image in English instead of the intended meaning of heavy rain.

source_text: I can't make it tonight, something came up.
reference_translation: Je ne peux pas venir ce soir, un imprévu est arrivé.
candidate_translation: Je ne peux pas venir ce soir, j'ai une urgence médicale très grave.

errors.candidate_span: j'ai une urgence médicale très grave
errors.note: Fabricates a 'serious medical emergency' not present in or implied by the vague source phrase 'something came up'.

judge_explanation: The vague 'something came up' is replaced with a fabricated, specific claim - "j'ai une urgence médicale très grave" (a very serious medical emergency) - that has no basis in the source and would mislead the listener about why the speaker is cancelling.

source_text: Eh mec, quelle soirée de ouf hier !
reference_translation: Hey dude, what a crazy party last night!
candidate_translation: Good evening sir, that was quite an unusual gathering yesterday.

errors.note: 'Eh mec' (informal, 'hey dude') and slang 'de ouf' are rendered as stiffly formal 'Good evening sir', a jarring register mismatch.

judge_explanation: The gist survives, but the wildly formal register completely misrepresents the casual, excited tone of the French original.

source_text: Can you send me the updated file by tomorrow morning?
reference_translation: Tu peux m'envoyer le fichier mis à jour pour demain matin ?
candidate_translation: Tu peux m'envoyer le fichier mis à jour pour demain matin ?
judge_explanation: Accurate and natural informal request, correctly using tu register consistent with a casual exchange.

source_text: Restart the router and wait for the lights to turn green before reconnecting.
reference_translation: Redémarrez le routeur et attendez que les voyants passent au vert avant de vous reconnecter.
candidate_translation: Redémarrez le routeur et attendez que les voyants passent au vert avant de vous reconnecter.
judge_explanation: Clear, accurate, natural technical instruction with correct formal vous register.

source_text: Clear your browser cache and reload the page.
reference_translation: Videz le cache de votre navigateur et rechargez la page.
candidate_translation: Videz le cache de votre navigateur et retéléchargez la page.

errors.note: 'Reload' (recharger) is mistranslated as 'redownload' (retélécharger), a distinct technical action.

judge_explanation: The overall instruction is roughly recoverable, but 'reload' (recharger) is mistranslated as 'retéléchargez' (redownload) - a distinct technical action that would send a user looking for a download rather than a refresh.

source_text: L'application mobile s'est mise à jour automatiquement hier soir.
reference_translation: The mobile app updated automatically last night.
candidate_translation: The mobile app updated automatically last night.
judge_explanation: 'L'application mobile s'est mise à jour automatiquement hier soir' is rendered completely and accurately as 'The mobile app updated automatically last night' - subject, tense, and the automatic/last-night details are all preserved.

source_text: Back up your files before installing the new firmware.

candidate_translation: Copiez vos fichiers avant d'installer le nouveau firmware.

errors.note: 'Sauvegarder' (to back up) is replaced with the weaker 'copier' (to copy), losing the specific safety-backup meaning.

judge_explanation: The instruction is still followable, but 'copier' is a less precise term than 'sauvegarder', slightly diluting the safety intent.

source_text: We regret to inform you that your application has not been shortlisted for the next round.
reference_translation: Nous avons le regret de vous informer que votre candidature n'a pas été retenue pour le tour suivant.
candidate_translation: Nous avons le regret de vous informer que votre candidature n'a pas été retenue pour le tour suivant.
judge_explanation: Accurate, appropriately formal vous register throughout, matching the genre of a rejection letter.

source_text: We regret to inform you that your application has not been shortlisted for the next round.
reference_translation: Nous avons le regret de vous informer que votre candidature n'a pas été retenue pour le tour suivant.
candidate_translation: Désolé de te dire que ta candidature est pas passée au tour suivant.

errors.note: Switches from formal 'vous' to informal 'tu' (te, ta) and drops the formal 'ne...pas' to colloquial 'pas', inappropriate for a formal rejection letter.

judge_explanation: The rejection fact survives, but the informal tu register and colloquial 'pas' construction are jarringly casual for a formal business letter.

source_text: Veuillez trouver ci-joint la facture correspondant à votre récent achat.
reference_translation: Please find attached the invoice for your recent purchase.
candidate_translation: Please find attached the invoice for your recent purchase.
judge_explanation: 'Veuillez trouver ci-joint la facture correspondant à votre récent achat' is rendered in matching formal correspondence register as 'Please find attached the invoice for your recent purchase', with no loss of meaning or formality.

source_text: This blender comes with a 2-year warranty, three speed settings, and a free recipe book.
reference_translation: Ce mixeur est fourni avec une garantie de 2 ans, trois vitesses et un livre de recettes gratuit.
candidate_translation: Ce mixeur est fourni avec une garantie de 2 ans, trois vitesses et un livre de recettes gratuit.
judge_explanation: All three listed features carry over intact: '2-year warranty' -> 'garantie de 2 ans', 'three speed settings' -> 'trois vitesses', and 'a free recipe book' -> 'un livre de recettes gratuit' - nothing added or dropped.

source_text: This blender comes with a 2-year warranty, three speed settings, and a free recipe book.
reference_translation: Ce mixeur est fourni avec une garantie de 2 ans, trois vitesses et un livre de recettes gratuit.
candidate_translation: Ce mixeur est fourni avec une garantie de 2 ans et trois vitesses.

errors.source_span: et un livre de recettes gratuit
