judge_explanation: Warranty ('garantie de 2 ans') and speed settings ('trois vitesses') are both correct, but the third listed feature - 'un livre de recettes gratuit' (a free recipe book) - is dropped entirely, which matters in a product listing a buyer relies on.

source_text: The smartwatch is priced at $199.99, a 20% discount from the original price.
reference_translation: La montre connectée coûte 199,99 $, soit 20 % de remise sur le prix initial.
candidate_translation: La montre connectée coûte 199,99 €, soit 20 % de remise sur le prix initial.

errors.note: The currency symbol is changed from US dollars to euros without conversion, misrepresenting the actual price.

judge_explanation: The number and 20% discount are correct, but '$199.99' silently becomes '199,99 €' in French with no currency conversion applied - swapping dollars for euros misrepresents the real price for a euro-zone reader.

source_text: Ce produit n'est disponible qu'en ligne et ne peut pas être retourné en magasin.
reference_translation: This product is only available online and cannot be returned in-store.
candidate_translation: This product is only available online and cannot be returned in-store.
judge_explanation: Both policy facts survive intact: 'disponible qu'en ligne' -> 'only available online' and 'ne peut pas être retourné en magasin' -> 'cannot be returned in-store'.

source_text: I don't think I can make it tonight, something came up.
reference_translation: Je ne pense pas pouvoir venir ce soir, un imprévu est arrivé.
candidate_translation: Je ne pense pas pouvoir venir ce soir, j'ai une réunion de travail urgente.

errors.candidate_span: j'ai une réunion de travail urgente
errors.note: Fabricates an 'urgent work meeting' not present in or implied by the vague source phrase.

judge_explanation: The vague 'something came up' is replaced with a fabricated specific - "j'ai une réunion de travail urgente" (an urgent work meeting) - which changes what the speaker is understood to have actually said, a fidelity error even though the subtitle line reads naturally.

source_text: Je n'arrive pas à croire que tu aies fait ça sans rien me dire.
reference_translation: I can't believe you did that without telling me anything.
candidate_translation: I can't believe you did that without telling me anything.
judge_explanation: Accurate, natural English preserving the subjunctive-driven reproach of the French original.

source_text: Don't cry over spilled milk, just move on.
reference_translation: Ce qui est fait est fait, il faut passer à autre chose.
candidate_translation: Ne pleure pas sur le lait renversé, avance juste.

errors.candidate_span: Ne pleure pas sur le lait renversé
errors.note: The literal rendering is comprehensible to a French reader but misses the more natural French equivalent 'ce qui est fait est fait', reading as translated rather than native.

judge_explanation: Comprehensible and not outright wrong (French does have a related expression), but the more natural equivalent is 'ce qui est fait est fait'; this near-literal rendering reads as translated.

source_text: Il a pris ses jambes à son cou et a disparu dans la foule.
reference_translation: He bolted and vanished into the crowd.
candidate_translation: He bolted and vanished into the crowd.
judge_explanation: Correctly renders 'prendre ses jambes à son cou' (literally 'take one's legs to one's neck') as the natural English idiom 'bolted' rather than a nonsensical literal translation.

source_text: The parties agree that this agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of California.
reference_translation: Les parties conviennent que le présent contrat sera régi par les lois de l'État de Californie.
candidate_translation: Les parties conviennent que le présent contrat sera régi par les lois de l'État de Californie.
judge_explanation: The governing-law clause is rendered with correct legal register throughout: 'shall be governed by the laws of the State of California' -> 'sera régi par les lois de l'État de Californie', with no hedging or informality introduced.

source_text: The Company shall not be liable for any indirect or consequential damages.
reference_translation: La Société ne sera pas responsable des dommages indirects ou consécutifs.
candidate_translation: La Société sera responsable des dommages indirects ou consécutifs.

errors.note: The negation 'ne...pas' is dropped entirely, reversing a liability-exclusion clause into a liability-acceptance clause.

judge_explanation: 'Shall not be liable' is rendered as 'sera responsable' (will be liable) - the negation 'ne...pas' is dropped entirely, reversing a liability-exclusion clause into a liability-acceptance clause, a critical error in a contract.

source_text: Le locataire devra verser la caution avant la signature du bail.
reference_translation: The tenant must pay the deposit before signing the lease.
candidate_translation: The tenant must pay the deposit before signing the lease.
judge_explanation: 'Le locataire devra verser la caution avant la signature du bail' is rendered with correct legal terminology as 'The tenant must pay the deposit before signing the lease' - 'caution' -> 'deposit' and 'bail' -> 'lease' are both standard equivalents.

source_text: Le contrat pourra être résilié pour manquement, moyennant un préavis écrit de 30 jours.
reference_translation: The contract may be terminated for breach, with 30 days' prior written notice.
candidate_translation: The contract may be terminated for breach.

errors.source_span: moyennant un préavis écrit de 30 jours
errors.note: The entire notice-period requirement ('préavis écrit de 30 jours') is dropped, a legally material condition.

judge_explanation: The right to terminate for breach is preserved, but 'moyennant un préavis écrit de 30 jours' (with 30 days' prior written notice) is dropped entirely - a legally material condition missing from the English rendering.

source_text: Take one tablet twice daily after meals with a full glass of water.
reference_translation: Prenez un comprimé deux fois par jour après les repas avec un grand verre d'eau.
candidate_translation: Prenez un comprimé deux fois par jour après les repas avec un grand verre d'eau.
judge_explanation: Every dosage detail in the source is preserved precisely: 'one tablet', 'twice daily', 'after meals', and 'a full glass of water' all carry over accurately into 'un comprimé', 'deux fois par jour', 'après les repas', and 'un grand verre d'eau'.

source_text: The recommended dose for adults is 500 mg every 8 hours, not exceeding 1500 mg per day.
reference_translation: La dose recommandée pour les adultes est de 500 mg toutes les 8 heures, sans dépasser 1500 mg par jour.
candidate_translation: La dose recommandée pour les adultes est de 50 mg toutes les 8 heures, sans dépasser 1500 mg par jour.

errors.note: A dropped zero changes the per-dose amount from 500 mg to 50 mg, a 10x understatement.

judge_explanation: '500 mg' is rendered as '50 mg' - a dropped zero that understates the recommended per-dose amount tenfold, a patient-safety issue that must be scored as unacceptable regardless of the sentence's otherwise fluent French.

source_text: Le patient présente une fièvre légère et un mal de gorge.
reference_translation: The patient has a mild fever and sore throat.
candidate_translation: The patient has a mild fever and sore throat.
judge_explanation: 'Une fièvre légère et un mal de gorge' is rendered precisely as 'a mild fever and sore throat', preserving both the severity qualifier ('mild', not just 'fever') and the second symptom exactly.

source_text: Les femmes enceintes ne doivent pas prendre ce médicament.
reference_translation: Pregnant women should not take this medication.
candidate_translation: Pregnant women should take this medication.

errors.note: Dropping the negation turns a contraindication warning into an instruction to take the medication.

judge_explanation: 'Les femmes enceintes ne doivent pas prendre ce médicament' (pregnant women should not take this medication) has its negation dropped, becoming 'Pregnant women should take this medication' - a contraindication warning reversed into an instruction to take the drug, among the most dangerous error categories in real deployment.

source_text: Our state-of-the-art software helps you scale your business seamlessly.
reference_translation: Notre logiciel de pointe vous aide à développer votre activité en toute simplicité.
candidate_translation: Notre logiciel de pointe vous aide à développer votre activité en toute simplicité.
judge_explanation: 'State-of-the-art' and 'seamlessly' are both adapted naturally rather than translated literally: 'logiciel de pointe' and 'en toute simplicité' read as native French marketing copy, not a stiff calque.

source_text: We are excited to announce our new range of products.
reference_translation: Nous sommes ravis d'annoncer notre nouvelle gamme de produits.
candidate_translation: Nous sommes énervés d'annoncer notre nouvelle gamme de produits.

errors.note: False-friend-adjacent error: 'excited' is mistranslated as 'énervé' (annoyed/irritated in standard French) instead of 'ravi'/'enthousiaste'; the sentence now claims the company is irritated.

judge_explanation: The mistranslation turns upbeat marketing copy into a claim that the company is annoyed to be launching its own products - the opposite of the intended tone.

source_text: Notre application est conçue pour simplifier votre quotidien.
reference_translation: Our app is designed to simplify your everyday life.
candidate_translation: Our app is designed to simplify your everyday life.
judge_explanation: 'Simplifier votre quotidien' (simplify your daily routine) is rendered naturally as 'simplify your everyday life' - an idiomatic, register-appropriate choice rather than a stiff literal rendering.

source_text: Your subscription will automatically renew on October 15th.

candidate_translation: Votre abonnement sera automatiquement renouvelé le 15 octobre.
judge_explanation: The renewal date is preserved exactly: 'October 15th' -> 'le 15 octobre', with 'automatically renew' correctly rendered as 'sera automatiquement renouvelé'.

source_text: The order will be delivered by 03/07/2026.
reference_translation: La commande sera livrée avant le 7 mars 2026.
candidate_translation: La commande sera livrée avant le 03/07/2026.

errors.note: Source uses US MM/DD/YYYY (March 7); digits are copied unchanged, where DD/MM/YYYY is standard in French - a reader would read this as 3 July.

judge_explanation: The digits are 'correct' but the date-format convention isn't localized, so a French reader will plausibly derive the wrong delivery date.

source_text: Nous avons besoin que vous confirmiez votre adresse e-mail pour continuer.
reference_translation: We need you to confirm your email address to continue.
candidate_translation: we need u to confirm ur email to continue

errors.note: Formal notice ('vous confirmiez') is rendered in texting-style abbreviations, inappropriate for an official account notice.

judge_explanation: The content is decodable, but the formal notice 'Nous avons besoin que vous confirmiez votre adresse e-mail' is rendered as lowercase texting-speak 'we need u to confirm ur email to continue' - jarringly unprofessional for an official account notice.

source_text: Check-in starts at 2 PM and check-out is by 11 AM; breakfast is included in the room rate.

source_text: The flight was delayed due to a crew scheduling issue.
reference_translation: Le vol a été retardé en raison d'un problème de planification d'équipage.
candidate_translation: Le vol a été retardé en raison d'un problème météorologique.

judge_explanation: The sentence is fluent French, but 'crew scheduling issue' is replaced with 'un problème météorologique' (a weather problem) - a plausible-sounding but simply wrong substituted cause.

candidate_translation: Tourists are advised to avoid closed trails.
judge_explanation: 'Il est conseillé aux touristes d'éviter les sentiers fermés' is rendered naturally as 'Tourists are advised to avoid closed trails', preserving both the advisory register and the specific 'closed trails' detail.

candidate_translation: Les étudiants doivent remettre la dissertation avant vendredi midi.
judge_explanation: The deadline is preserved exactly: 'before Friday noon' -> 'avant vendredi midi', with the academic-notice register kept consistent throughout.

judge_explanation: 'Report water leaks immediately to the utility company' is rendered completely and directly as 'signaler immédiatement toute fuite d'eau à la compagnie des eaux', matching the public-service notice register.

reference_translation: Garbage collection will be Monday mornings.
candidate_translation: Garbage collection will be Monday evenings.

errors.note: 'Matin' (morning) is mistranslated as 'evenings', giving residents the wrong collection time.

judge_explanation: 'Matin' (morning) is mistranslated as 'evenings' - fluent otherwise, but residents relying on this candidate would put out their garbage at completely the wrong time.

source_text: Do not touch the broken glass with bare hands.
reference_translation: Ne touchez pas le verre brisé à mains nues.
candidate_translation: Ne touchez pas le verre brisé à mains nues.
judge_explanation: Accurate, clear safety warning with correct formal vous imperative.

source_text: Do not touch the broken glass with bare hands.
reference_translation: Ne touchez pas le verre brisé à mains nues.
candidate_translation: Touchez le verre brisé à mains nues.

errors.note: The negation 'ne...pas' is dropped, turning a safety warning into an instruction to touch the broken glass.

judge_explanation: 'Ne touchez pas' (do not touch) has its negation dropped, becoming 'Touchez le verre brisé à mains nues' (touch the broken glass with bare hands) - a safety warning reversed into its dangerous opposite, a critical injury-risk error.

source_text: Portez des lunettes de protection lorsque vous coupez du métal.
reference_translation: Wear safety goggles when cutting metal.
candidate_translation: Wear safety goggles when cutting metal.
judge_explanation: 'Portez des lunettes de protection lorsque vous coupez du métal' is rendered precisely as 'Wear safety goggles when cutting metal' - the equipment, the hazard, and the imperative register are all preserved.

source_text: The bank was too steep, so they couldn't dock the boat.
reference_translation: La berge était trop escarpée, alors ils n'ont pas pu amarrer le bateau.
candidate_translation: La banque était trop escarpée, alors ils n'ont pas pu amarrer le bateau.

errors.note: 'Bank' here means riverbank (berge/rive), signaled by 'dock the boat', but is translated as 'banque' (financial bank).

judge_explanation: The disambiguating context ('couldn't dock the boat' / 'amarrer le bateau') clearly points to riverbank, but 'the bank' is translated as 'la banque' (financial bank) instead of 'la berge' or 'la rive' - the wrong sense of the homonym.

source_text: Le temps qu'il a fait était splendide, mais il n'avait pas le temps de sortir.
reference_translation: The weather was splendid, but he didn't have time to go out.
candidate_translation: The time it made was splendid, but he didn't have the time to go out.

errors.note: The first 'le temps' means 'the weather' here (idiom 'il fait beau temps'); the candidate literally renders it as 'the time', producing a nonsensical clause.

judge_explanation: This sentence plays on 'temps' meaning both 'weather' and 'time'; the candidate picks the wrong sense for the first occurrence, breaking grammar and meaning.

source_text: He filed the suit against his neighbor last week.
reference_translation: Il a déposé une plainte contre son voisin la semaine dernière.
candidate_translation: Il a déposé une plainte contre son voisin la semaine dernière.
judge_explanation: Correctly resolves the homonym 'suit' as 'plainte' (lawsuit) rather than 'costume' (clothing suit), using the disambiguating context accurately.

source_text: The girl wrote a long letter to her mother.
reference_translation: La fille a écrit une longue lettre à sa mère.

judge_explanation: 'Report water leaks immediately to the utility company' is rendered completely and directly as 'Wasserlecks sofort dem Versorgungsunternehmen melden', matching the public-service notice register.

source_text: Die Müllabfuhr findet montags morgens statt.
reference_translation: Garbage collection will be Monday mornings.
candidate_translation: Garbage collection will be Monday evenings.

errors.note: 'Morgens' (mornings) is mistranslated as 'evenings', giving residents the wrong collection time.

judge_explanation: 'Morgens' (mornings) is mistranslated as 'evenings' - fluent otherwise, but residents relying on this candidate would put out their garbage at completely the wrong time.

source_text: Do not touch the broken glass with bare hands.
reference_translation: Berühren Sie das zerbrochene Glas nicht mit bloßen Händen.
candidate_translation: Berühren Sie das zerbrochene Glas nicht mit bloßen Händen.
judge_explanation: Accurate, clear safety warning with correct formal Sie imperative.

source_text: Do not touch the broken glass with bare hands.
reference_translation: Berühren Sie das zerbrochene Glas nicht mit bloßen Händen.
candidate_translation: Berühren Sie das zerbrochene Glas mit bloßen Händen.

errors.note: The negation 'nicht' is dropped, turning a safety warning into an instruction to touch the broken glass.

judge_explanation: 'Nicht mit bloßen Händen' (not with bare hands) has its negation dropped, becoming 'Berühren Sie das zerbrochene Glas mit bloßen Händen' (touch the broken glass with bare hands) - a safety warning reversed into its dangerous opposite, a critical injury-risk error.

source_text: Tragen Sie eine Schutzbrille, wenn Sie Metall schneiden.
reference_translation: Wear safety goggles when cutting metal.
candidate_translation: Wear safety goggles when cutting metal.
judge_explanation: 'Tragen Sie eine Schutzbrille, wenn Sie Metall schneiden' is rendered precisely as 'Wear safety goggles when cutting metal' - the equipment, the hazard, and the imperative register are all preserved.

source_text: The bank was too steep, so they couldn't dock the boat.
reference_translation: Das Ufer war zu steil, sodass sie das Boot nicht anlegen konnten.
candidate_translation: Die Bank war zu steil, sodass sie das Boot nicht anlegen konnten.

errors.note: 'Bank' here means riverbank (Ufer), signaled by 'dock the boat', but is translated as 'Bank' (financial bank).

judge_explanation: The disambiguating context ('couldn't dock the boat' / 'das Boot nicht anlegen') clearly points to riverbank, but 'the bank' is translated as 'die Bank' (financial bank) instead of 'das Ufer' - the wrong sense of the homonym.

source_text: Er hat die Rechnung nicht bezahlt, aber die Rechnung im Kopf war trotzdem richtig.
reference_translation: He didn't pay the bill, but the calculation in his head was still correct.
candidate_translation: He didn't pay the invoice, but the invoice in his head was still correct.

errors.note: The second 'Rechnung' means 'calculation/arithmetic' here, not 'invoice'; translating both occurrences the same way produces an odd, less coherent sentence.

judge_explanation: 'Rechnung' can mean both 'bill/invoice' and 'calculation'; the candidate uses 'invoice' for both, missing the wordplay and producing an odd second clause ('the invoice in his head').

source_text: He filed the suit against his neighbor last week.
reference_translation: Er hat letzte Woche eine Klage gegen seinen Nachbarn eingereicht.
candidate_translation: Er hat letzte Woche eine Klage gegen seinen Nachbarn eingereicht.
judge_explanation: Correctly resolves the homonym 'suit' as 'Klage' (lawsuit) rather than 'Anzug' (clothing suit), using the disambiguating context accurately.

source_text: The girl wrote a long letter to her mother.
reference_translation: Das Mädchen schrieb ihrer Mutter einen langen Brief.
candidate_translation: Das Mädchen schrieb ihrer Mutter ein langen Brief.

errors.note: 'Brief' is masculine, so the accusative article should be 'einen', not the neuter 'ein'.

judge_explanation: Meaning is completely clear, but this article-gender agreement mistake is immediately noticeable as 'wrong German'.

source_text: Die Studierenden haben ihre Prüfungen beendet.
reference_translation: The students finished their exams.
candidate_translation: The students finished their exams.
judge_explanation: 'Die Studierenden haben ihre Prüfungen beendet' is rendered as 'The students finished their exams' with correct plural agreement throughout - 'students', 'their', and 'exams' are all consistently plural, matching the source.

source_text: Thank you for your patience while we resolve this issue.
reference_translation: Vielen Dank für Ihre Geduld, während wir dieses Problem lösen.

errors.note: Translation field is empty; no output was produced at all.

judge_explanation: An empty output is a complete task failure - there is nothing for a German reader to read.

source_text: Please confirm your email address to continue.
reference_translation: Bitte bestätigen Sie Ihre E-Mail-Adresse, um fortzufahren.
candidate_translation: Bitte bestätigen Sie Ihre E-Mail-Adresse, um fortzufahren bitte bestätigen Sie Ihre E-Mail-Adresse, um fortzufahren.

errors.note: The full sentence is looped twice before terminating - a classic degenerate-generation failure mode.

judge_explanation: The correct sentence 'Bitte bestätigen Sie Ihre E-Mail-Adresse, um fortzufahren' is produced, but the model then loops back and repeats it a second time before terminating - a degenerate-generation failure, not a meaning error.

source_text: Can you send me the updated invoice by tomorrow morning?
reference_translation: Kannst du mir die aktualisierte Rechnung bis morgen früh schicken?
candidate_translation: Can you send me the updated invoice by tomorrow morning?

errors.source_span: Can you send me the updated invoice by tomorrow morning?
errors.candidate_span: Can you send me the updated invoice by tomorrow morning?
errors.note: Output is identical to the source; no translation occurred at all.

judge_explanation: The model returned the English source unchanged, providing zero value to a German-only reader - a complete task failure.

source_text: Alle Mitarbeiter müssen die Sicherheitsschulung vor Monatsende abschließen, einschließlich des Erste-Hilfe-Moduls.
reference_translation: All employees must complete the safety training before the end of the month, including the first-aid module.
candidate_translation: All employees must complete the safety training before the end of the

errors.note: Output cuts off mid-sentence, dropping 'month' and the entire first-aid module requirement.

judge_explanation: The output cuts off after 'before the end of the', dropping both 'month' and the entire first-aid module clause ('einschließlich des Erste-Hilfe-Moduls') - an unusable, incomplete compliance instruction.

source_text: Open Instagram and tap the camera icon to start a new story.
reference_translation: Öffne Instagram und tippe auf das Kamerasymbol, um eine neue Story zu starten.
candidate_translation: Öffne Instagram und tippe auf das Kamerasymbol, um eine neue Story zu starten.
judge_explanation: Keeping 'Instagram' and 'Story' as commonly-used loanwords matches real-world German tech UI conventions; should NOT be penalized as 'untranslated'.

source_text: It's not rocket science, just follow the steps carefully.
reference_translation: Das ist keine Raketenwissenschaft, folge einfach sorgfältig den Schritten.
candidate_translation: Das ist keine Raketenwissenschaft, folge einfach sorgfältig den Schritten.
judge_explanation: German actually shares this idiom near-literally ('keine Raketenwissenschaft'), so the close rendering is correct and natural here, not a translation flaw; should not be penalized for resembling the source.

source_text: Der Plan ist echt der Hammer, wir ziehen das durch!
reference_translation: That plan is awesome, let's go for it!
candidate_translation: That plan is awesome, let's go for it!
judge_explanation: Correctly captures the colloquial intensifier 'der Hammer' (literally 'the hammer') and 'das durchziehen' with natural English equivalents rather than over-literal translation.

source_text: Sir, we appreciate your continued loyalty to our service.
reference_translation: Sehr geehrter Herr, wir schätzen Ihre anhaltende Treue zu unserem Service.
candidate_translation: Sehr geehrter Herr, wir schätzen Ihre anhaltende Treue zu unserem Service.
judge_explanation: Correctly matches the formal Sie/'Sehr geehrter Herr' register of the English 'Sir' address; should not be penalized for formality that fits the context.

source_text: Starten Sie den Datenbankdienst neu, nachdem Sie das Update installiert haben.
reference_translation: Restart the database service after installing the update.
candidate_translation: Restart the database service after downloading the update.

errors.note: 'Installieren' (install) is mistranslated as 'downloading', a distinct and earlier step than installation.

judge_explanation: 'Nachdem Sie das Update installiert haben' (after installing the update) is mistranslated as 'after downloading the update' - a distinct, earlier step, which could lead someone to restart the database service before the update is actually applied.

source_text: The central bank raised interest rates by 25 basis points on Thursday.
reference_translation: رفع البنك المركزي أسعار الفائدة بمقدار 25 نقطة أساس يوم الخميس.
candidate_translation: رفع البنك المركزي أسعار الفائدة بمقدار 25 نقطة أساس يوم الخميس.
judge_explanation: Accurate and fluent; correct financial terminology (نقطة أساس) and formal Modern Standard Arabic news register.

source_text: The government has not approved the merger between the two airlines.
reference_translation: لم توافق الحكومة على الاندماج بين شركتي الطيران.
candidate_translation: وافقت الحكومة على الاندماج بين شركتي الطيران.

errors.note: The negation particle 'لم' (jussive negation of the past) is dropped entirely, reversing the reported fact from 'has not approved' to 'has approved'.

judge_explanation: Fluent, well-formed Arabic that reports the exact opposite of the source fact - a critical reversal in a news item about a pending merger.

source_text: بلغ معدل التضخم السنوي 3.2 % في أغسطس.
reference_translation: Annual inflation stood at 3.2% in August.
candidate_translation: Annual inflation stood at 3.2% in August.
judge_explanation: 'بلغ معدل التضخم السنوي 3.2 % في أغسطس' is rendered precisely as 'Annual inflation stood at 3.2% in August' - the figure, the month, and the news register are all preserved exactly.

source_text: انخفضت نسبة البطالة إلى 5.8 % الشهر الماضي.
reference_translation: Unemployment fell to 5.8% last month.
candidate_translation: Unemployment fell to 8.5% last month.

errors.note: Digits transposed: source is 5.8%, candidate reports 8.5%.

judge_explanation: '5.8 %' in the Arabic source is transposed to '8.5%' in the candidate - a critical, materially wrong figure for an economic statistic, not a rounding or formatting difference.

source_text: Hey, are you free this weekend? Let's grab a coffee.
reference_translation: أهلاً، هل أنت متفرغ في نهاية هذا الأسبوع؟ يلا نشرب قهوة.
candidate_translation: أهلاً، هل أنت متفرغ في نهاية هذا الأسبوع؟ يلا نشرب قهوة.
judge_explanation: Natural, colloquial Arabic (using 'يلا') that matches the casual tone of the source rather than stiff MSA.

source_text: الدنيا بتشتي بغزارة، لا تنسى شمسيتك.
reference_translation: It's raining cats and dogs, don't forget your umbrella.
candidate_translation: The world is raining heavily, don't forget your umbrella.

errors.note: 'الدنيا بتشتي' (colloquial 'the world/weather is raining') is translated too literally as 'the world is raining', which reads oddly; 'it's raining' alone is the natural English equivalent.

judge_explanation: The meaning is recoverable but 'the world is raining' is an unnatural calque of the colloquial subject-drop construction; native English simply says 'it's raining heavily'.

source_text: I can't make it tonight, something came up.
reference_translation: لا أستطيع الحضور الليلة، طرأ أمر ما.
candidate_translation: لا أستطيع الحضور الليلة، لدي حالة طوارئ طبية خطيرة جداً.

errors.candidate_span: لدي حالة طوارئ طبية خطيرة جداً
errors.note: Fabricates a 'very serious medical emergency' not present in or implied by the vague source phrase 'something came up'.

judge_explanation: The vague 'something came up' is replaced with a fabricated, specific claim - "لدي حالة طوارئ طبية خطيرة جداً" (a very serious medical emergency) - that has no basis in the source and would mislead the listener about why the speaker is cancelling.

source_text: يا زلمة، شو الحفلة اللي صارت مبارح!
reference_translation: Dude, what a party last night!
candidate_translation: Good sir, quite an unusual gathering occurred yesterday.

errors.note: 'يا زلمة' (informal, 'dude') is rendered as stiffly formal 'Good sir', a jarring register mismatch for an excited casual exclamation.

judge_explanation: The gist survives, but the wildly formal register completely misrepresents the casual, excited tone of the colloquial Arabic original.

source_text: Can you send me the updated file by tomorrow morning?
reference_translation: ممكن ترسل لي الملف المحدث بحلول صباح الغد؟
candidate_translation: ممكن ترسل لي الملف المحدث بحلول صباح الغد؟
judge_explanation: Accurate and natural informal request, correctly using the colloquial 'ممكن' framing consistent with a casual exchange.

source_text: Restart the router and wait for the lights to turn green before reconnecting.
reference_translation: أعد تشغيل الراوتر وانتظر حتى تتحول الأضواء إلى اللون الأخضر قبل إعادة الاتصال.
candidate_translation: أعد تشغيل الراوتر وانتظر حتى تتحول الأضواء إلى اللون الأخضر قبل إعادة الاتصال.
judge_explanation: 'Restart the router and wait for the lights to turn green before reconnecting' is rendered completely and naturally as 'أعد تشغيل الراوتر وانتظر حتى تتحول الأضواء إلى اللون الأخضر قبل إعادة الاتصال' - all three steps are preserved.

source_text: Clear your browser cache and reload the page.

errors.note: 'Reload' (إعادة التحميل) is mistranslated as 'redownload' (إعادة التنزيل), a distinct technical action.

judge_explanation: The overall instruction is roughly recoverable, but 'reload' (إعادة التحميل) is mistranslated as 'أعد تنزيل الصفحة' (redownload the page) - a distinct technical action that would send a user looking for a download rather than a refresh.

source_text: تم تحديث التطبيق على الهاتف المحمول تلقائياً الليلة الماضية.
reference_translation: The mobile app updated automatically last night.
candidate_translation: The mobile app updated automatically last night.
judge_explanation: 'تم تحديث التطبيق على الهاتف المحمول تلقائياً الليلة الماضية' is rendered completely and accurately as 'The mobile app updated automatically last night' - subject, tense, and the automatic/last-night details are all preserved.

source_text: Back up your files before installing the new firmware.
reference_translation: قم بعمل نسخة احتياطية من ملفاتك قبل تثبيت البرنامج الثابت الجديد.
candidate_translation: انسخ ملفاتك قبل تثبيت البرنامج الثابت الجديد.

errors.note: 'نسخة احتياطية' (backup) is replaced with the weaker 'انسخ' (copy), losing the specific safety-backup meaning.

judge_explanation: The instruction is still followable, but 'انسخ' (copy) is a less precise term than 'نسخة احتياطية' (backup), slightly diluting the safety intent.

source_text: We regret to inform you that your application has not been shortlisted for the next round.
reference_translation: يؤسفنا إبلاغكم بأن طلبكم لم يتم اختياره للانتقال إلى الجولة التالية.
candidate_translation: يؤسفنا إبلاغكم بأن طلبكم لم يتم اختياره للانتقال إلى الجولة التالية.
judge_explanation: Accurate, appropriately formal plural-of-respect register throughout, matching the genre of a rejection letter.

source_text: We regret to inform you that your application has not been shortlisted for the next round.
reference_translation: يؤسفنا إبلاغكم بأن طلبكم لم يتم اختياره للانتقال إلى الجولة التالية.
candidate_translation: آسف أقولك إن طلبك ما مشى للجولة الجاية.

judge_explanation: The rejection fact survives, but the informal dialect register is jarringly casual for what should be a formal business letter.

candidate_translation: Please find attached the invoice for your recent purchase.
judge_explanation: 'مرفق طيه الفاتورة الخاصة بمشترياتكم الأخيرة' is rendered in matching formal correspondence register as 'Please find attached the invoice for your recent purchase', with no loss of meaning or formality.

source_text: This blender comes with a 2-year warranty, three speed settings, and a free recipe book.

candidate_translation: يأتي هذا الخلاط بضمان لمدة عامين وثلاث سرعات وكتاب وصفات مجاني.

source_text: This blender comes with a 2-year warranty, three speed settings, and a free recipe book.
reference_translation: يأتي هذا الخلاط بضمان لمدة عامين وثلاث سرعات وكتاب وصفات مجاني.

source_text: The smartwatch is priced at $199.99, a 20% discount from the original price.

candidate_translation: This product is only available online and cannot be returned in-store.
judge_explanation: Both policy facts survive intact: 'متوفر عبر الإنترنت فقط' -> 'only available online' and 'لا يمكن إرجاعه في المتجر' -> 'cannot be returned in-store'.

source_text: I don't think I can make it tonight, something came up.
reference_translation: أظن أنني لن أستطيع الحضور الليلة، طرأ أمر ما.
candidate_translation: أظن أنني لن أستطيع الحضور الليلة، لدي اجتماع عمل عاجل.

errors.note: Fabricates an 'urgent work meeting' not present in or implied by the vague source phrase.

judge_explanation: The vague 'something came up' is replaced with a fabricated specific - "لدي اجتماع عمل عاجل" (an urgent work meeting) - which changes what the speaker is understood to have actually said, a fidelity error even though the subtitle line reads naturally.

source_text: لا أصدق أنك فعلت ذلك دون أن تخبرني بأي شيء.
reference_translation: I can't believe you did that without telling me anything.
candidate_translation: I can't believe you did that without telling me anything.
judge_explanation: Accurate, natural English preserving the reproachful tone of the Arabic original.

source_text: Don't cry over spilled milk, just move on.
reference_translation: ما فات مات، تجاوز الأمر وامضِ قدماً.
candidate_translation: لا تبكِ على الحليب المسكوب، فقط تابع طريقك.

errors.note: The literal rendering is comprehensible to an Arabic reader but misses the more natural Arabic equivalent 'ما فات مات', reading as translated rather than native.

judge_explanation: Comprehensible and not outright wrong, but the more natural Arabic equivalent is 'ما فات مات' (what's past is dead); this near-literal rendering reads as translated.

source_text: طار عقله من الخوف واختفى بين الحشود.
reference_translation: He panicked and vanished into the crowd.
candidate_translation: He panicked and vanished into the crowd.
judge_explanation: Correctly renders 'طار عقله' (literally 'his mind flew') as the natural English idiom 'he panicked' rather than a nonsensical literal translation.

source_text: The parties agree that this agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of California.
reference_translation: يتفق الطرفان على أن تخضع هذه الاتفاقية لقوانين ولاية كاليفورنيا.
candidate_translation: يتفق الطرفان على أن تخضع هذه الاتفاقية لقوانين ولاية كاليفورنيا.
judge_explanation: The governing-law clause is rendered with correct legal register throughout: 'shall be governed by the laws of the State of California' -> 'تخضع هذه الاتفاقية لقوانين ولاية كاليفورنيا', with no hedging or informality introduced.

source_text: The Company shall not be liable for any indirect or consequential damages.
reference_translation: لا تتحمل الشركة المسؤولية عن أي أضرار غير مباشرة أو تبعية.
candidate_translation: تتحمل الشركة المسؤولية عن أي أضرار غير مباشرة أو تبعية.

errors.note: The negation particle 'لا' is dropped entirely, reversing a liability-exclusion clause into a liability-acceptance clause.

judge_explanation: 'Shall not be liable' is rendered as 'تتحمل الشركة المسؤولية' (the company is liable) - the negation particle 'لا' is dropped entirely, reversing a liability-exclusion clause into a liability-acceptance clause, a critical error in a contract.

source_text: يجب على المستأجر دفع التأمين قبل توقيع عقد الإيجار.
reference_translation: The tenant must pay the deposit before signing the lease.
candidate_translation: The tenant must pay the deposit before signing the lease.
judge_explanation: 'يجب على المستأجر دفع التأمين قبل توقيع عقد الإيجار' is rendered with correct legal terminology as 'The tenant must pay the deposit before signing the lease' - 'التأمين' -> 'deposit' and 'عقد الإيجار' -> 'lease' are both standard equivalents.

source_text: يجوز فسخ العقد في حالة الإخلال بشرط تقديم إشعار كتابي مسبق مدته 30 يوماً.
reference_translation: The contract may be terminated for breach, with 30 days' prior written notice.
candidate_translation: The contract may be terminated for breach.

errors.source_span: بشرط تقديم إشعار كتابي مسبق مدته 30 يوماً
errors.note: The entire notice-period requirement ('إشعار كتابي مسبق مدته 30 يوماً') is dropped, a legally material condition.

judge_explanation: The right to terminate for breach is preserved, but 'بشرط تقديم إشعار كتابي مسبق مدته 30 يوماً' (with 30 days' prior written notice) is dropped entirely - a legally material condition missing from the English rendering.

source_text: Take one tablet twice daily after meals with a full glass of water.
reference_translation: تناول قرصاً واحداً مرتين يومياً بعد الوجبات مع كوب كامل من الماء.
candidate_translation: تناول قرصاً واحداً مرتين يومياً بعد الوجبات مع كوب كامل من الماء.
judge_explanation: Every dosage detail in the source is preserved precisely: 'one tablet', 'twice daily', 'after meals', and 'a full glass of water' all carry over accurately into 'قرصاً واحداً', 'مرتين يومياً', 'بعد الوجبات', and 'كوب كامل من الماء'.

source_text: The recommended dose for adults is 500 mg every 8 hours, not exceeding 1500 mg per day.
reference_translation: الجرعة الموصى بها للبالغين هي 500 ملغ كل 8 ساعات، دون تجاوز 1500 ملغ يومياً.
candidate_translation: الجرعة الموصى بها للبالغين هي 50 ملغ كل 8 ساعات، دون تجاوز 1500 ملغ يومياً.

errors.note: A dropped zero changes the per-dose amount from 500 mg to 50 mg, a 10x understatement.

judge_explanation: '500 mg' is rendered as '50 ملغ' - a dropped zero that understates the recommended per-dose amount tenfold, a patient-safety issue that must be scored as unacceptable regardless of the sentence's otherwise fluent Arabic.

source_text: يعاني المريض من حمى خفيفة والتهاب في الحلق.
reference_translation: The patient has a mild fever and sore throat.
candidate_translation: The patient has a mild fever and sore throat.
judge_explanation: 'حمى خفيفة والتهاب في الحلق' is rendered precisely as 'a mild fever and sore throat', preserving both the severity qualifier ('mild', not just 'fever') and the second symptom exactly.

source_text: لا يجب على النساء الحوامل تناول هذا الدواء.
reference_translation: Pregnant women should not take this medication.
candidate_translation: Pregnant women should take this medication.

source_text: Do not touch the broken glass with bare hands.

source_text: The bank was too steep, so they couldn't dock the boat.

errors.note: 'Bank' here means riverbank (ضفة), signaled by 'dock the boat', but is translated as 'مصرف' (financial bank).

judge_explanation: The disambiguating context ('couldn't dock the boat' / 'إرساء القارب') clearly points to riverbank, but 'the bank' is translated as 'المصرف' (financial bank) instead of 'ضفة النهر' - the wrong sense of the homonym.

source_text: ذهب إلى العين ليصلح ساعته بجانب عين الماء.

errors.note: 'العين' can mean 'eye', 'watchmaker/spring source', or 'water spring' depending on context; the candidate picks the literal 'eye' sense for both occurrences, producing a nonsensical sentence.

judge_explanation: 'عين' is highly polysemous in Arabic (eye / spring / notable person); the candidate defaults to the literal 'eye' sense throughout, missing both intended meanings.

judge_explanation: The subject is unambiguously feminine plural, so the masculine predicate agreement is a clear grammar error a native speaker would immediately flag, even though meaning is recoverable.
